Job Title: Senior Journalist, BBC Focus On Africa
Job Description:
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
We are looking for a highly successful Senior Journalist to supervise the production and outputting of Focus on Africa TV program as well as its digital livestreams and assets and, whenever necessary, do the radio/podcast output. The Senior Journalist will lead a talented team to produce engaging and informative content that resonates with our global audience while reflecting the rich diversity and complexities of African stories. You will be an experienced journalist with experience of handling breaking news and rolling coverage and good understanding of our audience needs.
WHY JOIN THE TEAM
Focus on Africa is BBC’s flagship news and current affairs program for our audiences in Africa and those interested in African stories across the world. The program, across TV, radio and digital platforms, aims to provide a comprehensive view of the diverse experiences, cultures, and challenges facing African nations and their people. This includes engaging stories on politics, economics, environment, health, and social issues, along with highlighting achievements and innovations within Africa.
Focus on Africa aims to bridge the gap between African societies and global audiences, offering a platform for voices that often go unheard. The program seeks to foster understanding, promote dialogue, and celebrate the richness of African life by presenting high-quality journalism that motivates, educates, and informs viewers.
YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT:
Lead the editorial planning, development, and production of Focus on Africa content, delivering engaging, accurate, and visually compelling stories that resonate with African audiences across broadcast and digital platforms.
Manage and develop a high-performing production team by providing leadership, coaching, constructive feedback, and professional development opportunities, while fostering a culture of creativity, innovation, and inclusion.
Ensure all content meets BBC editorial standards for accuracy, impartiality, fairness, and quality by reviewing and approving scripts, video packages, and other editorial output prior to publication or broadcast.
Drive audience growth and engagement by overseeing digital output, including podcasts and social media, using audience insights, analytics, market research, and feedback to inform content and digital expansion strategies.
Build and maintain strong relationships with correspondents, contributors, BBC departments, and international bureaux to enhance coverage, source compelling stories, and deliver collaborative cross-platform content.
Promote diversity in both workforce and output by maintaining broad and diverse contributor networks, sharing knowledge across teams, reflecting the needs of audiences served, and deputising for the Assistant Editor when required.
YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
ESSENTIAL CRITERIA:
Proven success in producing, commissioning, and delivering high-quality television, digital, and streaming content, with a strong track record in original journalism, daily news output, and current affairs programming.
Extensive experience working in fast-paced breaking news environments, with a strong understanding of African affairs, global news, and wider cultural, entertainment, and sporting developments.
Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to lead collaborative editorial teams, mentor less experienced colleagues, delegate effectively, and drive cross-team partnerships.
Excellent editorial judgement, including significant experience in script editing, sub-editing, video production, and managing complex legal, compliance, and editorial policy issues.
Strong digital storytelling expertise, including the production of impactful online content, podcasts, and social media output, alongside a good understanding of audience engagement, analytics, and digital best practice.
Skilled researcher and communicator, with the ability to analyse complex information, write and edit engaging content for diverse audiences, and communicate clearly and effectively in English.
Knowledge of data and visual journalism, combined with a commitment to diversity and inclusion, cultural awareness, and sensitivity in reporting; experience of filming is desirable.

About the Senior Product Manager role
Our team is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own processing at Paystack.
Every payment we handle depends on the channels we support and the partner rails that carry the transaction, and your job is to make that layer broader, faster, and more dependable.
You'll own the payment methods and channels available to merchants and their customers, the relationships and integrations with the banks, card schemes, and processors that sit behind them, and the reliability of the processing stack they run on.
This is a hands-on role requiring strong ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to operate effectively across engineering, data, and partner-facing teams.
The successful candidate will work closely with engineering, data, commercial, and external partners across our markets.
The role reports to the Head of Product. It is strongly preferred if the candidate is based in Lagos, Nigeria.
We’ll trust you to
Own the product strategy and roadmap for payment processing at Paystack, covering channels, partner rails, and the reliability of the processing stack.
Expand and improve the payment methods and channels available to merchants, including cards, bank transfers, and direct debit, across our markets.
Drive improvements in transaction success rates and authorization performance across every channel we support.
Own the product relationship with banks, card schemes, processors, and other partner rails, working with them to improve connectivity, performance, and coverage.
Assess and prioritise new partner integrations, and make the case for where we connect next and why.
Hold partners to account on performance, working with them to resolve the issues that cause transactions to fail.
Own the reliability and uptime of the processing stack, and drive the work needed to keep it high as volume grows.
Reduce transaction failures and improve resilience, including retries, failover, and how we handle partner downtime.
Optimise transaction latency and throughput so that processing stays fast and dependable at scale.
Use transaction data to identify where payments fail, slow down, or drop off by channel and by partner, and turn those insights into roadmap priorities.
Define the metrics that matter for processing, such as success rate, authorization rate, latency, and uptime, and hold the team and our partners to them.
Translate merchant and market needs into clear product requirements for channel and partner work.
Make trade-off decisions across coverage, performance, cost, and reliability.
Partner with commercial and market teams to support the expansion of payment capabilities into new markets.
You’ll thrive in this role if you have
6+ years of product management experience, with a strong track record of shipping complex, technical products.
Prior experience with payments, financial infrastructure, or other high-scale transactional systems is a strong asset.
Experience working with external partners such as banks, processors, or card schemes, and the ability to hold them to a performance standard.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work directly with transaction data to find and prioritise problems.
Technical fluency; comfortable working closely with engineers on the systems that process payments, and reasoning about performance, resilience, and reliability trade-offs.
Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Strong project management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple workstreams at once, follow through, and meet deadlines.
Action- and results-oriented, with the ability to demonstrate good judgment in a fast-paced, high-growth, dynamic environment.
Sound judgment even in ambiguous situations.
An open and curious mind about an evolving industry, humility, and a terrific sense of humor.

Job Description:
About The Role
You'll manage and oversee Gravv Capital's crypto-asset financial services and keep them compliant with FSCA, FAIS and FICA requirements. You'll work closely with senior management, compliance, product, engineering and operations teams across the group, so that the business operates within the scope of its FSCA authorisation.
You must meet the Fit and Proper requirements for a Key Individual. These cover competence, qualifications, the regulatory examination, experience, operational ability, CPD, and honesty, integrity and good standing.
What You'll Do
Key Individual and regulatory oversight
Act as the designated Key Individual, subject to FSCA approval.
Manage and oversee Gravv Capital's authorised crypto-asset financial services.
Keep crypto-asset activities within the scope of the firm's FSCA licence, and assess new products, services or business changes for licensing impact before launch.
Maintain compliance with the FAIS Act, the General Code of Conduct and applicable FSCA requirements.
Monitor regulatory developments affecting crypto-asset financial services, and advise management on their impact.
Prepare and support regulatory submissions, notifications and correspondence with the FSCA.
Help the FSCA and other regulators with inspections, audits and information requests.
Compliance function
Implement and maintain the firm's compliance policies and procedures, aligned with Kredete group policies where appropriate.
Conduct or coordinate compliance monitoring and testing, and report findings to management.
Maintain regulatory records, registers and compliance documentation.
Identify and escalate regulatory and compliance risks to senior management.
Provide practical compliance guidance to business, product and operational teams.
Lead regulatory training and awareness for staff and representatives.
FICA, AML/CFT and sanctions
Oversee compliance with FICA, AML/CFT, targeted financial sanctions and applicable FIC directives, including the Travel Rule for crypto-asset service providers.
Support KYC, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence and transaction monitoring processes.
Oversee the maintenance of the firm's Risk Management and Compliance Programme (RMCP).
Support suspicious and unusual transaction reporting and other regulatory reporting to the FIC.
Fit and Proper and competence
Maintain the firm's Fit and Proper competence records for Key Individuals and representatives. These include qualifications, regulatory examinations, product and class-of-business training, and CPD, as the FSCA requires.
General
Perform any other duties reasonably required by the Company in connection with the Key Individual role, regulatory compliance, the management and oversight of the Company's authorised financial services and crypto-asset activities, and the effective operation of the compliance function.
Mandatory Requirements
You must:
Have passed the FSCA RE1 Regulatory Examination for Key Individuals.
Hold an FSCA-recognised qualification for the relevant financial product or product sub-category.
Have 1–3 years' relevant experience in financial services, fintech, crypto assets, compliance, AML or regulatory affairs.
Know the FAIS Act and the FSCA regulatory framework.
Know FICA, AML/CFT, KYC/EDD and sanctions compliance.
Have demonstrable knowledge of crypto assets and crypto-asset financial services.
Meet the honesty, integrity and good-standing requirements, and not be debarred.
Show the operational ability and capacity to carry out the responsibilities of a Key Individual.
Be willing and able to complete ongoing CPD and maintain the role's competence requirements.
Be willing to undergo background, criminal record, credit and qualification checks.

The role is to provide support to the in-house Litigation team in the management of high risk and complex litigation and arbitration matters in the areas of legal research, litigation filing/document management, evidential defence materials collation, maintaining and updating Matter Management System, electronic management of litigation documentation, pre-trial witness preparation support, management of court administrative interface for witness deposition filings , external counsel interface management, and other litigation related support in the management of Litigation.
The Paralegal also provides secretariate support for litigation management & reduction focused projects, maintains accurate records, preparations of reports and presentations for internal and external stakeholders, thus contributing to the delivery of litigation outcomes that protect the Company’s interests, support cost control, and adds business value.
Responsibilities
Under the direction and supervision of Legal Counsel:
Coordinate and gather information from requisite Line departments to aid the preparation of pleadings, and other legal documents
Locate the information source
Liaise with the team responsible
Obtain the relevant information/documents including videos and pictures
Coordinate the gathering of information, materials, documents, reports and evidence necessary to respond to discovery, Interrogatories and pleadings
Collect information/documents from relevant Line departments
Collate evidence materials for companies’ defence
Make necessary photocopies of identified materials for defence
Review materials with in-house Legal Counsel
Send copies of agreed materials to external counsel
Index and store original copies of materials and make them available when necessary to be tendered in court.
Locating the appropriate witnesses necessary to prosecute or defend a suit in court
Locate appropriate witness to defend a suit in court (In-house/third party)
Make contacts with the appropriate witnesses
Provide witness with copies of pleadings filed to aid familiarization on issues in dispute in the suit
Schedule pre-trial briefing with in-house & outside counsel
Make logistic arrangements for the witness and where necessary accompany witnesses to file depositions and other relevant court processes.
Support the Team Lead in the:
Preparation of periodic reports on Litigations for diverse interna and external stakeholders
Carry out extensive analysis of litigation data to identify patterns, trends, and underlying factors for decision making.
Preparation of presentations for senior business management, CoVs and JV Partners briefings.
Carry out Site visits/Locus checks and summarize findings relevant for prosecuting or defending a claim:
Provide a report summarizing findings relevant to issues in dispute in a suit.
Provide reasons why materials/data collated are useful or not useful for the purpose of the litigation.
Maintain records of materials and data used in Litigation for ease of reference and precedent purposes.
Coordinate the taking of still or video photographs or sound recordings necessary for evidence in court when needed
Liaise with the media department to provide video & photographers where necessary
Liaise with the media department to provide necessary equipment when needed
Collate videos/audio tapes necessary for evidence in court
Conduct first line due diligence, including document verification, statistical & documentary research and reviewing these as required.
Draft correspondence as directed to line clients, external lawyers, witnesses etc. (provided such correspondence does not contain legal opinion or advice).
Court interface:
Management of court administrative interface
Visit Court registries and court rooms to make enquiries, obtain hearing dates, submit letters and receive hearing notices.
Certify and file documents, as required.
Interface with Litigation Monitoring Contract Contracts/personnel for the purpose of obtaining information on ongoing matters.
Interface with court bailiffs and other court officials
Accept service of court processes
Manage court processes on individual staff members
Document management
Matter Management System (MMS)
Update entries in MMS
Collate and upload relevant court processes, evidential materials and correspondences in MMS
Litigation filing/document management
Maintain and keep custody of physical case files
Maintain secure custody of evidential materials
Ensure compliance with filling requirements of the
Electronic management of litigation records/document
Manage electronic filing of litigation documents in the Legal Document management System (LDMS).
Maintain the integrity of litigation documents in LDMS.
Budget Management Support:
Support the Legal Counsel in the review of External counsel, Experts and Contractor invoices for processing and payment. Interface with and respond to Vendor’s enquires and complaints in respect of their payments.
Support the Team Lead and Legal counsel responsible for the annual Litigation budget in the preparation of budget estimates, quarterly performance reviews and assessment of Latest estimates to ensure full cost recovery.
Provide data analysis, Presentation and Secretariat support: -
Prepare quarterly and ad-hoc reports on Litigation matters to various Business departments, JV partners and external stakeholders
Prepare the Teams’ presentation materials on litigation data and management for internal and external stakeholders; tracking of External counsel firm’s performance, Department’s briefing trends etc
Provide secretariate support for diverse Legal and companywide collaborate projects; Litigation team projects for de-risking and reduction of the portfolio; the bi-monthly team meeting; Integrity Due Diligence Team for external vendors, and maintenance of sundry tracking Registers.
provide sundry services incidental to the Team’s goals and to enhance team cohesion
Main Challenges
Part of a team of 3 paralegals working with 11 lawyers to support the management of circa 900 litigation matters with significant claim values, reputational and operational exposure. Interface with internal clients and external stakeholders, including external counsel, court officials, law enforcement agencies, and expert witnesses.
Regular travels to court locations. Access to confidential documents and legally privileged communications.
Role is specifically responsible for supporting Three In-house counsel in the management of circa 340 cases.
This position requires excellent research, record keeping, observation, planning and analytical skills. Must be versatile in preparing Presentation packs, data review and analysis plus Report writing.
Strong personal effectiveness skills with a pragmatic attitude are needed to ensure the most effective and efficient support is given to Legal Counsel in the management of litigation given tight court deadlines and competing demands from pending and new cases that come in weekly.
Support litigation budget preparation and performance reviews internally and with Joint Venture partner to ensure no rejected cost. Part of team that oversees cost management through spend tracking, review for payment of invoices from external counsel, experts, and vendors in relation to litigation management and acts as Integrator to get evidence of tax remission from Finance/Vendor services team to the Law firms.
Provide factual and procedural research support on litigation, arbitration, and contentious matters before Nigerian courts, international arbitral tribunals, and courts overseas.

A Bachelor's degree from a reputable organization

5
years' work experience
Computer literacy and proficiency particularly in data analysis, Microsoft Excel, and PowerPoint applications.
Good command of written and spoken English.
Prior experience as a Litigation clerk or Practice Administrator in a Law firm and/or a diploma in law would be an added advantage.
Good Well-developed drafting and negotiation skills.
Leadership skills, capacity to work independently and as part of a team
Ability to build and sustain relationships with business and external stakeholders.
Ability to work under pressure, prioritize multiple competing activities and remain positive in challenging circumstances.

Result driven self-starter with good business partnering skills and customer focus.

Job Description:
Objectives
This role reports to the Centre Coordinator, the Locum Sonographer job exists to perform quality ultrasound examinations to clients and make quality reports to assist the physician with the diagnosis and treatment.
The Sonographer’s role and responsibilities include providing diagnostic medical sonography services and its various clinical specialties.
The Sonographer’ activities are performed consistent with their education and training, and in accordance with MSI policies, procedures, and applicable professional standards.
Overall Responsibilities
Your responsibilities as Locum Sonographer shall include;
Review client medical history and supporting clinical information and communicate with the client in a manner appropriate to the client’s ability to understand the procedure.
Conduct client clinical assessment and perform the diagnostic medical sonography examination ordered by the supervising physician in accordance with professional and facility protocols.
Review examination images, synthesize examination results, and prepare the preliminary findings.
Apply independent judgment during the sonography examination to ensure that appropriate anatomical, pathological, and clinical conditions are accurately captured in the examination images.
Assume responsibility for the safety of the client during the sonographic examination.
Maintain client privacy and confidentiality in accordance with privacy laws and facility policies, and procedures.
Use proper client positioning tools, devices, equipment adjustment, and ergonomically correct scanning techniques to ensure client comfort and safety, and to prevent compromised data acquisition and musculoskeletal injury to the sonographer.
Generate demand for ultrasound services by collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to drive client volumes.
Prepare exam room and ultrasound equipment to conduct sonography examinations in accordance with infections disease, sterilization, and client safety protocols, policies, and procedures.
As necessary, acquire additional ultrasound imaging to facilitate optimum diagnostic results for the interpreting physician.
Identify and document any limitations to the sonography examination and escalate as appropriate.
Assume responsibility for the preventive maintenance for ultrasound equipment to ensure it operates at optimal level at all times.
Operate the Picture Archiving and Communication System (PACS).
Support marketing events to optimize imaging business with the community and also building up a reliable referral network of specialise scans.
Key Experience / Qualifications
Diploma in Ultrasound, Medical Imaging Sciences or Radiography from a recognized institution.
At least two years working experience as a sonographer in a reputable hospital / medial facility.
Registration with the relevant regulatory or professional body if applicable with a current practicing license.
Computer literate.
Knowledge of relevant legislations.

Support merit increase, bonus and promotion exercises based on appraisal outcomes.

Identify competency gaps together with department leads; design and coordinate internal & external training programs.
Manage training logistics, training budgets, track training attendance and maintain training records.
Support talent development, internal mobility and career development initiatives.

Draft, update, communicate and implement HR policies, employee handbook aligned with Nigerian Labour Act and local statutory regulations.
Maintain personnel files (hard copy & HRIS), ensure document confidentiality, data privacy and audit readiness.
Monitor regulatory changes of Nigeria employment law and update internal processes accordingly.

Maintain employee master data in HR Information System (HRIS); ensure high‑quality, real‑time employee records.
Generate regular & ad‑hoc HR reports: headcount, turnover / attrition rate, absenteeism, manpower cost, recruitment KPIs, training metrics for management review.

Daily Office Administration and Operation and Corporate Activities

Job Title: NGA-RFP-012-26 Social Protection Services in Sokoto State - Consultancy Services
Job Description:
Purpose of the consultancy
In Sokoto State, the Danish Refugee Council (DRC), through the European Union-funded Support for Protection Assistance and Durable Solutions (SPADS) project, seeks to strengthen the foundation for a more inclusive, coordinated, and shock-responsive social protection system. Recognizing the critical role of social protection in reducing poverty, building resilience, and supporting sustainable graduation pathways, DRC plans to undertake a comprehensive social protection consultancy aimed at supporting the Government of Sokoto State to strengthen its institutional architecture, coordination mechanisms, and implementation capacity.
The consultancy will assess the current social protection landscape in Sokoto State and compare it with existing structures and best practices from other states in North-West Nigeria. Particular attention will be given to examining how existing social assistance, social services, livelihoods programming, and economic inclusion initiatives can be better integrated to support pathways that enable vulnerable households to move from dependency to self-reliance. The assessment will identify institutional strengths, system gaps, coordination challenges, and opportunities for aligning social protection interventions with economic recovery and resilience-building initiatives.
A comprehensive actor mapping exercise will be conducted to identify government institutions, development partners, civil society organizations, community structures, and private sector actors contributing to social protection outcomes in Sokoto State. This mapping will clarify roles, mandates, service coverage, referral pathways, and coordination arrangements, while highlighting opportunities to improve collaboration and reduce duplication of services.
The assignment will also include a two-day stakeholder workshop bringing together duty bearers at different levels of governance, development partners, civil society, and other relevant stakeholders to review assessment findings, validate recommendations, and identify strategic opportunities for strengthening social protection systems.
Drawing on findings from the assessment, consultations, and capacity-strengthening activities, the consultancy will culminate in the development of a Social Protection Implementation Framework for Sokoto State. The framework will provide a practical roadmap for enhancing coordination mechanisms, improving service delivery systems, integrating economic inclusion and graduation pathways, and promoting resilience to climate, economic, and social shocks. Ultimately, the consultancy aims to support Sokoto State in establishing a more effective and sustainable social protection system that better protects vulnerable populations, promotes self-reliance, and contributes to long-term socio-economic development.
Eligibility, qualification, and experience required
Essential:
Professional Experience
The Consultant should demonstrate:
A minimum of 8-10 years of progressively responsible experience in social protection, poverty reduction, economic inclusion, livelihoods, or institutional systems strengthening.
Demonstrated experience supporting government-led social protection reforms and policy implementation.
Proven experience conducting institutional assessments, stakeholder mapping, political economy analysis, and systems diagnostics.
Experience designing or supporting social protection frameworks, strategies, policies, or implementation plans at national or subnational levels.
Experience facilitating multi-stakeholder consultations, technical working groups, and government coordination platforms.
Strong experience producing high-quality analytical reports, policy papers, and strategic planning documents.
Desirable:
The following will be considered an added advantage:
Previous experience supporting World Bank, EU, UNICEF, ILO, UNDP, GIZ, or other donor-funded social protection programmes.
Experience with the National Social Protection Policy and Nigeria's social investment architecture.
Experience developing State Social Protection Strategies or Implementation Frameworks.
Knowledge of adaptive social protection, climate financing, and resilience-building programming.
Experience supporting graduation-focused programming and economic inclusion initiatives.
Eligibility

A financial proposal.

Additional professional training or certification in social protection, livelihoods, resilience, public sector reform, monitoring and evaluation, or related areas will be considered an advantage.

Job Summary
The Supply Planner is responsible for ensuring the continuous availability of raw materials and finished products across both local and export markets, while actively managing inventory health and supporting new product introductions.
Operating in a fast-paced, Excel-driven environment, the role demands strong analytical discipline, proactive risk identification, and structured communication with commercial and operations stakeholders.
The successful candidate will own a defined portfolio of SKUs for both local and export markets, maintain planning rigour across the full replenishment cycle, and contribute meaningfully to working capital improvement and supply risk reduction
Principal Accountabilities
Supply Planning & Inventory Management:
Maintains stock cover, safety stock levels and replenishment schedules for a defined portfolio of raw materials and finished products for the Nigeria market.
Develop and drive execution of supply plans for locally produced finished products and leads weekly production planning discussions.
Leads end-to-end intercompany replenishments from providing visibility via purchase forecasts, to firming orders with production planners in line with agreed lead time and demand signals to ensuring timely delivery of shipments to warehouses through careful coordination with the imports team.
Manage import planning cycles (intercompany raw materials and imported finished products), tracking shipment ETAs and flagging deviations proactively.
Ensure zero out-of-stock events, especially for Class A & B finished product items and all directly managed raw materials
Export Supply Compliance:
Coordinate export supply requirements in line with the aligned out from the Supply Review Meeting (SRM) and ensure compliance.
Plan and confirm stuffing schedules for export requirements with the Customer Excellence and Logistics team, and drive zero missed vessel schedules.
Proactively communicate shortfalls and supply risks to the export market representatives.
SLOB and Working Capital Management:
Proactively identify SKUs at risk of entering SLOB status and escalate recommended actions to prevent it.
Drive reduction of current finished goods SLOB profile through coordination with commercial stakeholders.
Track and report slow-moving and SLOB stock position.
Drive container optimization for intercompany orders to manage landed costs.
New Product Launch Support:
Coordinate feedstock availability for all new product launches; ensure availability no less than 90 days before planned production/launch.
Proactively communicate flags and risks for new product launches.
Maintain a launch planning tracker and participate in cross-functional pre-launch readiness reviews
Reporting and Stakeholder Communication:
Publish month-end supply reports (SLOB, Days of Cover, Supply Risk (within 2 working days of month close, maintaining a consistent standard.
Communicate OOS risk to commercial and demand planning stakeholders no less than 90 days for forecast review and/or commercial replanning.
Continuous Improvement:
Sustain and iteratively improve personal planning workflow and Excel-based tools to increase planning accuracy; proactively identify and document emerging supply risks on a structured basis to reduce reactive escalations.
Requirements
Essential:
3–6 years of hands-on experience in supply planning, materials planning, or inventory management within an FMCG, manufacturing, or services environment.
Demonstrable proficiency in Excel-based planning (advanced formulas, structured tracking tools, scenario modelling).
Proven experience managing replenishment cycles for both local and import/export supply chains.
Strong numerical literacy and comfort working with large, complex data sets to derive planning decisions.
Experience producing and presenting structured supply or inventory reports to management or cross-functional stakeholders.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
Desirable:
Exposure to ERP systems (JDE, SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) in a planning or inventory role.
Familiarity with S&OP/IBP ideologies.
Experience in working capital management, SLOB reduction programmes, or inventory optimisation projects.
Understanding of international supply chain coordination.
Key Competencies:
Analytical Rigour: makes decisions based on structured data; maintains accurate, reliable planning records.
Structured Communication: produces clear, concise written reports and verbal updates to stakeholders at all levels.
Collaboration: works effectively with production, commercial, logistics, warehousing and finance teams despite limited cross-functional authority.
Proactive Risk Management: identifies supply risks early and communicates them with enough lead time to act.
Ownership & Accountability takes end-to-end responsibility for their portfolio without needing to be prompted.
Continuous Improvement Mindset: consistently looks for ways to reduce manual effort and improve planning quality.

Job Description:
About the Role
This is the role that protects the founders' attention and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.
Paul runs growth, paid media, the website, financing and the numbers. Kanma runs creative direction, product, procurement and supplier relationships. Both of them currently spend hours every week on work that does not need them personally: scheduling, chasing follow-ups, preparing documents, researching suppliers and partners, booking travel, writing first drafts, and remembering what everybody else owes them.
You will take that work off them. You will run their calendars, hold the follow-up list for the whole founders' office, prepare them for every meeting they walk into, draft the outreach and the documents, and chase the people who owe them answers until the loop is closed.
This is an execution role with real ownership, and it is deliberately not a junior one. Nobody will hand you a task list every morning. You are expected to see what is coming, prepare for it, and tell the founders what they have forgotten. The best people in this role become the person the whole team asks "what did Paul decide?" before they ask Paul.
This is not a strategy role, and it is not a management role. You will not make business decisions, negotiate deals, or run a department. You make it possible for the people who do those things to do them well.
What You'll Own
Calendar, Inbox and Meeting Preparation
Own both founders' calendars: booking, moving, protecting focus blocks, and resolving the clashes before either founder sees them
Run the week ahead: by Friday, both founders know every meeting they have the following week and what each one is for
Prepare a short brief before every external meeting: who the person is, what was agreed last time, what we want out of this one, and what we owe them
Support the founders' inboxes where delegated: triage, draft replies for approval, flag what genuinely needs them, and file the rest
Capture decisions and actions in every meeting you sit in, and get them into Notion the same day
The Follow-Up Engine
Hold the master list of everything either founder is waiting on, from whom, and by when
Chase the team, suppliers, partners and service providers until each loop is actually closed, not just sent
Track commitments the founders have made to other people, and make sure we deliver on them before we are asked
Run a short, honest weekly check-in with each founder on what moved, what is stuck, and what they are about to miss
Escalate early. A missed deadline you flagged on Monday is a problem; one you flagged on Friday is an incident
Outreach and Relationship Coordination
Maintain the founders' contact and relationship pipelines in Notion: partners, press, stockists, creators, investors and service providers
Draft personalised first-touch outreach and follow-ups in the ÌTURA voice, for founder approval
Coordinate first conversations, book them, prepare the founders for them, and follow up afterwards
Prepare introductions, one-pagers and meeting materials so a founder never walks into a conversation cold
Research, Documents and AI-Assisted Execution
Run research the founders ask for and research they have not thought to ask for: suppliers, venues, events, partners, competitors, service providers, costs
Turn that research into a decision-ready document: what the options are, what each costs, what you recommend, and what you need from them
Prepare proposals, decks, briefing notes and meeting summaries
Use AI tools properly as a drafting and research accelerator, and check everything before it reaches a founder. You are accountable for what you hand over, not the tool
Travel, Logistics and Personal Admin
Book and coordinate travel, accommodation, reservations and local logistics for both founders
Handle the recurring personal admin that competes with founder time: renewals, appointments, deliveries, filings and errands that need a reliable owner
Keep the founders' files, documents and shared drives organised and findable
What Success Looks Like
Neither founder is doing their own scheduling, and neither has missed a commitment they were not warned about
Every external meeting either founder walks into has a brief attached to it
The follow-up list is live, current and honest, and the team knows you will chase them
Founders spend their week on decisions, partnerships, creative direction and growth, not on admin
Research requests come back as decisions to make, not as raw links
When a founder is travelling or heads-down, the office still runs
Who You'll Work With
You report to Paul, Co-Founder and CEO, and support Kanma, Co-Founder, on equal footing.
You will work closely with:
Anu, Head of Business Operations, on scheduling, operational alignment and anything that touches the wider team
Tobi, Procurement Manager, on supplier research, sample logistics and purchase coordination
Annie, Morolake and Emmanuel on the content team, when founder work touches shoots, ads or the brand calendar
Jasmine, Talent Assessment Lead, on interview scheduling and candidate logistics

The ICT Officer will be based in Yola, Adamawa State, providing onsite and remote ICT support to the Yola office, Yobe field locations and programme teams across Plan International Nigeria. The role will work closely with the Country Office ICT team, programme teams and service providers to ensure reliable, secure and effective ICT infrastructure, connectivity, systems and end-user services, while supporting country-level ICT initiatives and ensuring alignment with organizational standards and programme requirements.
Key Responsibilities
ICT Infrastructure, Connectivity and Power Resilience
Administer, monitor and maintain LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN and other network infrastructure at the Yola office and assigned programme/field locations.
Configure, maintain and troubleshoot routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points and other network infrastructure in accordance with approved technical standards.
Support connectivity solutions including fibre, radio, VSAT, Starlink and other satellite or wireless technologies where applicable.
Support telecommunications and emergency communication systems, including satellite phones, BGAN and radio communications, where required.
Administer, monitor and support CCTV/IP surveillance systems, NVRs, cameras and associated network infrastructure.
Support the deployment, monitoring and maintenance of ICT power and backup systems, including UPS units, inverters, batteries, solar systems and other power-resilience solutions supporting critical ICT infrastructure.
Monitor ICT infrastructure availability, performance and capacity and escalate major or recurring issues appropriately.
Carry out preventive maintenance and coordinate corrective maintenance of ICT infrastructure and equipment.
Microsoft 365, Cloud, Systems and End-User Technology
Provide technical support for Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive and related applications.
Support Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD, Active Directory and identity and access management.
Support user onboarding, access changes and offboarding in accordance with approved processes.
Support the deployment and management of laptops, desktops, mobile devices, printers and other ICT equipment.
Ensure end-user devices are appropriately configured, patched, encrypted and protected in accordance with organizational standards.
Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, operating-system, printing and peripheral-related issues.
Coordinate equipment repairs, warranty claims and replacement of defective ICT equipment.
IT Service Management and User Support
Respond to and resolve ICT incidents and service requests within agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Operational Level Agreements (OLAs).
Provide onsite and remote technical support to users through appropriate support channels.
Maintain accurate records of incidents, service requests, resolutions and escalations within the organization's IT service-management system.
Identify recurring technical problems and recommend sustainable solutions.
Escalate complex or major incidents to the IT Coordinator, Regional/Global IT teams or approved external support providers as appropriate.
Maintain a strong customer-service approach and ensure users receive timely and effective technical assistance.
Cybersecurity, Data Protection and Access Control
Implement and maintain ICT security controls in accordance with Plan International's information-security policies and standards.
Support endpoint protection, antivirus/EDR, encryption, patch management and vulnerability remediation.
Support the implementation and maintenance of MFA, access controls and other identity-security measures.
Provide guidance to users on protecting organizational and programme information, devices and networks against malware, unauthorized access, data loss and physical damage.
Support the identification, reporting and escalation of cybersecurity incidents.
Promote secure technology practices and awareness among staff.
Support compliance with applicable data-protection, privacy and information-security requirements.
ICT Support to Programme Operations
Work with programme and operations teams to understand ICT requirements and provide appropriate technical solutions.
Provide ICT support for programme activities, trainings, workshops, deployments, new project locations and office setups.
Participate in requirements gathering, system testing, user acceptance testing, implementation, rollout and post-implementation support.
Ensure ICT solutions implemented for programme activities comply with organizational architecture, cybersecurity and data-protection requirements.
Identify and recommend appropriate technology solutions that can improve programme delivery, operational efficiency and service quality.
Propose and support technology initiatives, automation and digitalization opportunities in coordination with the Country Office ICT team.
IT Asset, Vendor and Contract Management
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of ICT hardware, software, network equipment, CCTV, power/backup equipment and other technology assets.
Support the lifecycle management of ICT assets, including deployment, transfer, repair, replacement and disposal.
Support the management of ICT licences, warranties, maintenance agreements and support contracts.
Provide technical input into the selection and procurement of ICT equipment, software, connectivity and services.
Support the evaluation and management of ICT vendors and service providers and monitor delivery against agreed requirements.
Ensure adequate availability of essential ICT supplies and equipment for operational requirements.
Backup, Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
Perform and monitor approved backup operations for critical applications, systems, network configurations and other ICT resources.
Support backup and recovery of network-device configurations and critical infrastructure documentation.
Participate in business-continuity and disaster-recovery planning, testing and implementation.
Support restoration of ICT services during power outages, connectivity failures, equipment failures, emergencies and other disruptions.
Identify ICT infrastructure risks and recommend measures to improve service resilience and continuity.
Documentation, Training and Knowledge Management
Maintain up-to-date technical documentation, network diagrams, configurations, procedures, asset records and user guides.
Develop or contribute to standard operating procedures and knowledge-base materials.
Organize and support ICT induction, awareness and end-user training activities.
Provide guidance and basic ICT administration training to designated field staff where appropriate.
Share technical knowledge, lessons learned and good practices with Country Office, Regional and Global IT teams.
Support continuous improvement of ICT processes and services.
Compliance and Service Quality
Ensure ICT services and infrastructure comply with Plan International's corporate standards, approved architecture, policies and procedures.
Monitor the quality and availability of ICT services provided to assigned locations.
Support the implementation and monitoring of agreed ICT service standards and SLAs/OLAs.
Ensure appropriate documentation, controls and escalation procedures are followed.
Perform other ICT-related duties assigned by the supervisor.
General Responsibilities
Manage IT-related documentation and ensure availability of necessary IT supplies.
Gather user requirements and assist in developing reports for IT professionals.
Fulfil additional tasks assigned by the supervisors.
Work collaboratively with other members of the Plan International Nigeria team.
Report directly to the IT Coordinator and with matrix management to the ZARCH Project Coordinator.
Safeguarding
The
IT Officer
shall:
Commit and contribute to an environment where children and programme participants feel respected, supported, safe and protected;
Never act or behave in a manner that results in violence against a child or programme participant or places a child or programme participant at risk of violence;
Be aware of and adhere to the provisions of the Global Safeguarding Policy and Safeguarding Code of Conduct including the PII Prevention of Sexual Harassment Exploitation and Abuse Policy in public and private life; and:
Report and respond to safeguarding concerns and breaches of the policies immediately in line with the applicable procedures of Plan International Nigeria.
Develop knowledge and skills for implementing safeguarding and PSHEA standards, including Delivering Safe IT and Digital Safeguarding and other related standards.
About You
We are looking to recruit person(s) with;
University degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Electrical/Electronic Engineering or a related field.
Completion of NYSC is compulsory.
Minimum of 4 years' relevant experience in ICT, IT infrastructure, networking, systems administration or user support.
Practical experience managing and supporting Cisco Meraki network infrastructure, including switches, wireless access points and security appliances.
Good knowledge of the Meraki Dashboard, including network monitoring, configuration, troubleshooting, firmware updates, VLANs, wireless networks, firewall policies and VPNs.
Experience supporting LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, routers, switches and firewalls.
Experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID/Azure AD and Active Directory.
Good knowledge of Windows operating systems, DNS, DHCP and Group Policy.
Experience supporting laptops, desktops, printers and other ICT equipment.
Good understanding of cybersecurity, access control, MFA, endpoint security and data protection.
Experience supporting cloud-based applications and services.
Experience with ICT connectivity technologies such as fibre, Starlink, VSAT, radio and other wireless solutions.
Experience supporting CCTV/IP surveillance and ICT backup-power systems, including UPS, inverters, batteries and solar systems, is an advantage.
Experience providing IT support to users both onsite and remotely.
Good written and spoken English communication skills.
Experience working in an NGO, humanitarian or field-based environment is an advantage.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to resolve moderate to complex technical issues.
Ability to provide effective onsite, remote and telephone-based IT support.
Ability to communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical users.
Strong interpersonal, communication, listening and customer-service skills.
Ability to think creatively and identify practical technology solutions.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to urgent requests and incidents.
Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships in a multicultural and diverse environment.
Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with teams.
Strong personal accountability, adaptability and commitment to continuous learning.

Plan International was founded over 75 years ago with a mission to promote and protect the rights of children.

Our vision is of a world in which all children realize their full potential in societies that respect people's rights and dignity.

Plan strives to achieve lasting improvements in the quality of life of vulnerable children in developing countries by:
Enabling children, their families and their communities to meet basic needs and to increase their ability to participate in and benefit from their societies;

Promoting the rights and interests of the world’s children.

Job Description:
BBC World Service is evolving its editorial team in Lagos while future-proofing its journalism to meet changing media consumption habits across sub-Saharan Africa.
BBC News Igbo is one of the most trusted international news providers for audiences across West Africa and a highly engaged global diaspora.
With a strong editorial heritage, the service is entering an exciting new phase: transforming into a video-led operation designed to reach a new generation of Igbo audiences who primarily consume news via smartphones and social media.
BBC News Igbo is changing into a story-led model built around two complementary editorial streams: On the Day and On Demand.
Why Join The Team?
The Journalist is the core production resource of both streams. Whether working a morning, afternoon or night shift within On the Day, or contributing to planned video and podcast production within On Demand, the Journalist is expected to move fluently between platforms, formats and roles (such as writing a web article, filming a clip, voicing a radio package and publishing a social post), often on the same story, within the same shift.
This transformation demands journalists who are not simply willing to work across platforms, but who think across platforms instinctively.
That means asking, before production begins, how a story will serve audiences on the website, on Instagram, on TikTok and on radio or TV, and making deliberate choices about format, length and angle for each.
Responsibilities
Create and publish accurate, engaging and SEO-friendly news content for the BBC Igbo website, ensuring timely updates and high editorial standards.
Produce, present, shoot and edit short-form video content for platforms including TikTok, Instagram and Facebook, using strong storytelling and visual production skills.
Develop compelling social media content that drives audience engagement, expands reach and supports content discovery across digital platforms.
Respond quickly to breaking news, maintaining a consistent flow of content across the website and social channels throughout the day.
Use audience analytics and performance insights to inform content decisions and continuously improve digital output.
Contribute to BBC Igbo’s visualised radio programming, presenting confidently on air and on screen for both broadcast and streaming audiences.
Repurpose live radio and interview content into engaging digital clips, maximising audience reach across social media and the BBC Igbo website.
Requirements
Proven experience creating engaging content across digital, social, radio and video platforms, with a strong understanding of audience needs and platform best practice.
Excellent writing, reading, editing and storytelling skills in Igbo, with the ability to produce accurate, engaging and SEO-aware content to tight deadlines.
Strong video production skills, including presenting, self-shooting and editing content for platforms such as YouTube, TikTok,
Instagram Reels and Facebook – added advantage.
Confident using audience analytics, headlines, thumbnails and metadata to optimise content performance, discoverability and engagement.
Experience sourcing, verifying and reporting news accurately and impartially, including handling breaking news and user-generated content.
Strong broadcast skills, including radio production, interviewing and presenting for live, on-demand and visualised programme formats.
Fluent in Igbo and English, with a good understanding of the political, social and cultural landscape of Nigeria and wider West Africa, and the needs of Igbo-speaking audiences.

The Senior Journalist role is also central to the production of visualised podcasts designed to attract young and female audiences who increasingly consume news through video and on-demand platforms.

Oversee the production of short form video content for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube, turning daily news stories into high performing digital assets.
Drive continuous publishing across BBC Pidgin's website and social channels, commissioning and editing compelling news, video and audience focused content that grows engagement.
Lead the development and production of BBC Pidgin’s visualised podcast, delivering engaging content on trending issues and topics that matter to younger audiences.
Use audience insights and performance analytics to shape editorial decisions, optimise content and identify opportunities for growth across platforms.
Manage BBC Pidgin's live and visualised radio output, ensuring high editorial and technical standards while maximising opportunities for digital distribution and streaming.
Coach and develop journalists in cross platform storytelling, digital production and video journalism, while fostering collaboration across teams to deliver innovative content.

Proven experience leading digital first news operations, with a strong understanding of audience engagement, content performance and growth across digital platforms.
Full fluency in written and spoken Pidgin and English
Expertise in commissioning, editing and publishing content across multiple platforms, including news websites, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and other social channels.
Strong knowledge of audience analytics and the ability to use data and insights to make real time editorial and commissioning decisions.
Excellent news judgement and the ability to identify stories with strong digital potential, shaping them into engaging formats such as explainers, live blogs, Q&As and short form video.
Experience producing or overseeing visualised broadcast content, with a clear understanding of how to create compelling experiences for both audio and on-screen audiences.
Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to motivate, coach and develop teams while maintaining high standards in fast paced and high-pressure environments.
Outstanding writing, scripting and editing skills in Pidgin and English, combined with excellent communication, planning and stakeholder management abilities.

About the role
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytically rigorous Security & Technology Risk Analyst to join our Information Security Assurance Team at Moniepoint. In this role, you will be instrumental in identifying, monitoring, and reporting on security and technology operational
risks across our fintech ecosystem.
You will translate complex risk data into actionable intelligence that enables executive leadership to make informed strategic decisions while ensuring our organization maintains the highest standards of regulatory compliance and operational resilience.
As a financial technology company, trust and security are foundational to our brand. Your work directly contributes to Moniepoint's ability to safely expand into new markets, launch innovative products, and maintain the confidence of our customers and stakeholders.

Conduct comprehensive risk assessments across security and technology domains (cloud, network, infrastructure, product, endpoint, third-party) using NIST Risk Management Framework, FAIR methodology, and qualitative/quantitative analysis methods.
Perform Business Impact Analysis (BIA) on critical systems to determine Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO), collaborating with process owners to validate findings and maintain documentation as business operations evolve.
Administer and maintain the security risk register with current and historical records, ensuring comprehensive documentation and audit evidence for regulatory examinations and internal/external audits.
Guide development and documentation of risk treatment plans aligned with enterprise risk appetite, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders (Engineering, Legal, DevOps, IT, Security) on prioritization, execution strategies, and integration into product development and operational processes.
Track and validate execution of risk treatment plans, monitoring completion rates, escalating delays, and ensuring residual risk remains within tolerance levels while adjusting plans as needed based on mitigation and remediation progress.
Design and maintain quantifiable risk metrics across exposure measurement, control effectiveness assessment, and risk treatment progress tracking for executive decision-making, with continuous monitoring against organizational risk appetite thresholds via real-time dashboards and reporting.
Analyze emerging threats and regulatory changes to proactively surface new risks and support strategic initiatives including market expansion and new product launches.
Ensure all security and technology risk management activities adhere to applicable financial regulations, industry standards, and relevant frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, NDPA, NIST, FAIR).
Support security teams in evaluating third-party and vendor risks, ensuring alignment with organizational security standards and conducting ongoing risk assessments as part of the vendor management program.
Communicate risk findings, assessments, and recommendations in business-relevant terms to stakeholders at all levels, translating technical risk concepts into actionable intelligence for executive leadership and operational teams.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Risk Management, Engineering, or related field.
5+ years of professional experience in operational risk management, cybersecurity risk, or technology risk assessment.
Demonstrated experience conducting risk assessments, threat analysis, or vulnerability management.
Experience developing risk metrics, KPIs, or dashboards for executive audiences.
Familiarity with risk management frameworks (e.g., NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001 or similar)
Experience in financial services, fintech, or regulated industries preferred.
Proficiency in risk assessment methodologies and qualitative/quantitative analysis
Knowledge of business continuity and disaster recovery planning principles

Experience with fintech, banking, or other highly-regulated industries

Job Description:
Job Summary
The Human Resource Officer (HRO) will play a key role in ensuring the efficient and effective management of the organisation’s human capital.
This role focuses on strengthening HR systems, promoting staff welfare, and fostering a culture of professionalism, accountability, and excellence.
The HRO will manage core HR functions, including recruitment, performance management, employee relations, policy administration, and capacity development. The role also requires providing strategic input to management on workforce planning and organisational development initiatives.
Above all, the HRO must be a proactive, ethical, and emotionally intelligent professional who values integrity, confidentiality, and teamwork, and who demonstrates commitment to creating a supportive and high-performing workplace.
Key Responsibilities
Recruitment and Onboarding:
Lead the end-to-end recruitment process, including job design, posting, shortlisting, interviewing, and reference checks.
Prepare and issue offer letters, contracts, and onboarding materials for new staff.
Coordinate induction programmes to ensure seamless integration of new employees into the organisation.
Maintain an updated talent pool database for potential hires and consultants.
Employee Relations and Welfare:
Serve as the first point of contact for employee concerns, complaints, and welfare matters.
Facilitate the resolution of conflicts and grievances through fair and transparent processes.
Promote open communication, inclusivity, and staff engagement across departments.
Develop and support employee well-being initiatives, health and safety practices, and team-building activities.
Performance Management and Staff Development:
Oversee the implementation of the organisation’s performance appraisal framework.
Monitor staff performance, provide feedback, and support managers in addressing performance gaps.
Identify training needs and coordinate staff development programmes to enhance competencies and career growth.
Document and track professional development outcomes for continuous improvement.
Policy and Compliance Management:
Support the review, update, and implementation of HR policies and procedures.
Ensure organisational compliance with national labour laws, employment standards, and ethical practices.
Maintain accurate and confidential personnel records for all employees.
Conduct periodic policy awareness sessions to promote understanding and adherence among staff.
Payroll Administration and HR Operations:
Work with the finance team to ensure accurate and timely preparation of the monthly payroll.
Maintain attendance, leave management, and time-tracking systems.
Oversee the administration of employee benefits, including health insurance, pension, and statutory deductions.
Ensure accurate documentation and reporting of HR operations and workforce data.
Organisational Culture and Employee Engagement:
Promote a work culture rooted in respect, transparency, accountability, and continuous learning.
Develop strategies to improve employee motivation, morale, and retention.
Support management in executing recognition programmes and culture-building initiatives.
Encourage teamwork, inclusivity, and effective communication across the organisation.
Performance Expectations:
Demonstrates excellence, accuracy, and professionalism in all HR operations.
Ensures all recruitment, onboarding, and administrative processes are timely and transparent.
Maintains updated HR documentation and submits periodic reports to management.
Promotes a positive and supportive work culture that aligns with the organisation’s values.
Ensures compliance with all internal policies and legal regulations.
Contributes to the organisation’s mission by ensuring that staff are motivated, productive, and well-supported.
Qualifications and Experience
Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resource Management, Industrial Relations, Business Administration, or a related discipline (Master’s degree is an advantage).
3–5 years relevant experience in HR management, preferably within the non-profit, development, or corporate sector.
Strong understanding of Nigerian labour laws, HR principles, and regulatory frameworks.
Excellent communication, writing, and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and HR information systems.
Experience managing recruitment, performance evaluation, and employee engagement initiatives.
Key Attributes:
Professional, confidential, and trustworthy in handling sensitive employee information.
Strong attention to detail with excellent organisational and time management skills.
Emotionally intelligent, empathetic, and approachable.
Proactive, self-driven, and solutions-oriented.
Demonstrates fairness, integrity, and discretion at all times.
Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
Passionate about staff development, welfare, and institutional growth.

Job Description:
Job Overview
We are seeking an exceptional, highly experienced, and results-driven Executive Assistant to provide strategic, administrative, operational, and personal support to the CEO.
This is not a traditional administrative role.
The successful candidate will serve as a trusted right-hand to the CEO, managing high-level business priorities, executive operations, stakeholder relationships, confidential matters, and personal responsibilities with minimal supervision.
The ideal candidate must possess 5–10 years of proven Executive Assistant experience supporting senior executives, business leaders, founders, or C-suite professionals in fast-paced and demanding environments.
She must be highly intelligent, proactive, discreet, resourceful, and capable of anticipating needs before they arise.
The role requires a mature professional who can manage complex schedules, coordinate multiple priorities simultaneously, drive projects to completion, represent the CEO professionally, and maintain absolute confidentiality.
The ability to drive confidently within Lagos and possess a valid driver's licence is mandatory.
Key Responsibilities
Executive Office Management:
Manage the CEO's calendar, appointments, meetings, and commitments with exceptional accuracy.
Coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly schedules to ensure maximum productivity.
Prioritise competing demands and make informed decisions regarding scheduling conflicts.
Manage all incoming communications, including emails, calls, correspondence, and requests.
Prepare executive reports, presentations, briefing documents, proposals, and meeting materials.
Maintain comprehensive records, databases, and filing systems.
Ensure timely follow-up on tasks, deliverables, and executive decisions.
Handle highly confidential information with the highest level of discretion.
Strategic Executive Support:
Serve as a strategic partner to the CEO on key business initiatives.
Track organisational priorities, projects, and deliverables.
Monitor deadlines and ensure accountability across teams.
Prepare research reports, executive summaries, and business intelligence documents.
Support planning and execution of strategic projects and special assignments.
Anticipate challenges and proactively develop solutions before escalation.
Stakeholder and Relationship Management:
Act as the primary liaison between the CEO and internal/external stakeholders.
Coordinate communication with clients, partners, board members, investors, government officials, and senior executives.
Represent the CEO professionally during meetings and engagements when required.
Build and maintain strong professional relationships on behalf of the CEO.
Ensure all stakeholder interactions reflect the CEO's standards and expectations.
Project Management and Coordination:
Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring timely execution.
Develop tracking systems for projects, meetings, action items, and deliverables.
Follow up with internal and external stakeholders to ensure commitments are fulfilled.
Prepare project status reports and progress updates.
Support planning and execution of corporate events, meetings, conferences, and executive engagements.
Travel and Logistics Management:
Manage local and international travel arrangements.
Coordinate flights, accommodation, transportation, visas, travel documentation, and itineraries.
Ensure seamless logistics for business meetings, conferences, and events.
Anticipate travel-related risks and proactively resolve issues.
Personal and Lifestyle Management:
Manage personal schedules, appointments, and commitments for the CEO.
Coordinate household operations and supervise domestic staff where required.
Manage personal errands and lifestyle-related responsibilities.
Oversee family schedules, logistics, and special arrangements.
Track personal and household expenses and maintain accurate records.
Operational Excellence:
Create and maintain efficient administrative systems and processes.
Identify operational gaps and recommend practical solutions.
Ensure seamless coordination between business and personal priorities.
Maintain a high level of organisation, professionalism, and efficiency at all times.
Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and ownership of responsibilities.
Performance Expectations
Success in this role will be measured by:
Effective management of the CEO's schedule and priorities.
Ability to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise.
Timely completion of assignments and deliverables.
Accuracy and quality of documentation and reporting.
Strong stakeholder relationship management.
Exceptional organisational and administrative efficiency.
Demonstrated ownership, initiative, and reliability.
Consistent professionalism in representing the CEO.
Required Qualifications
Education:
Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related field.
Professional certifications in Project Management, Executive Administration, Office Management, or related disciplines will be an added advantage.
Experience:
Minimum of 5 years and maximum of 10 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, Executive Administrator, Senior Personal Assistant, or similar role.
Must have extensive experience supporting CEOs, Managing Directors, Chairpersons, Founders, or other C-suite executives.
Proven experience managing both executive and personal responsibilities simultaneously.
Demonstrated success operating in high-pressure and fast-paced environments.
Experience coordinating senior-level stakeholders and executive engagements.
Mandatory Requirements:
Female candidates only.
Must possess a valid driver's licence.
Must be a confident and experienced driver with excellent knowledge of Lagos roads.
Must reside within reasonable proximity to Lagos Island.
Preferred locations include: Ikoyi, Victoria Island, Lekki, Oniru, Ajah and Chevron Axis.
Core Competencies:
Executive Competencies:
Executive Office Management
Calendar and Time Management
Stakeholder Management
Strategic Coordination
Business Communication
Project Management
Research and Analysis
Meeting Coordination
Travel Management
Event Coordination.
Technical Skills:
Microsoft Office Suite (Advanced Level)
PowerPoint Presentation Development
Excel Reporting and Analysis
Google Workspace
Digital Documentation Systems
Virtual Collaboration Platforms.
Personal Attributes:
The ideal candidate must be:
Exceptionally organised and highly structured.
Extremely proactive and solution-oriented.
Mature, professional, and emotionally intelligent.
Calm and composed under pressure.
Highly dependable and accountable.
Assertive yet respectful.
Able to exercise sound judgment independently.
Discreet and trustworthy with sensitive information.
Detail-oriented with strong follow-through.
Polished, articulate, and well-presented.
Capable of maintaining professional boundaries.
Able to work effectively with minimal supervision.
Ideal Candidate Profile:
The successful candidate is not merely an assistant but a highly experienced executive support professional who functions as an extension of the CEO.
She possesses the maturity, confidence, business acumen, and execution capability required to manage complex executive responsibilities while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and confidentiality.
She is capable of thinking ahead, solving problems independently, managing demanding schedules, coordinating multiple stakeholders, and ensuring that both business and personal obligations of the CEO are executed seamlessly.
This role is best suited for a seasoned Executive Assistant who thrives in high-performance environments and is committed to excellence.

Job Description:
Job Summary
The Senior Operations Manager is the most senior operational authority on site, accountable directly to management for the day-to-day running, standards, and performance of the property. This is a leadership appointment, not a supervised or entry-level role: the successful candidate is expected to take full ownership of operations from day one, exercise independent judgement, and command the authority to direct staff, contractors, and vendors with minimal oversight.
The Senior Operations Manager will define and embed the standards, systems, and culture of operational excellence that the property runs on. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that all apartments are guest-ready, facilities are fully functional, operational processes run efficiently, and staff maintain professionalism and accountability.
This position requires a highly organised, proactive, and disciplined individual with strong leadership skills, excellent communication ability, operational intelligence, and the capacity to work effectively in a fast-paced luxury hospitality environment. The ideal candidate must be able to manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and operational excellence.
Key Responsibilities
Leadership and Operational Authority:
Take full, independent ownership of daily operations across all departments, front desk, housekeeping, kitchen, maintenance, security, drivers, and gardening.
Set the tone for professionalism, discipline, and accountability across the operational team; lead by direct example rather than instruction.
Exercise sound, confident decision-making on operational matters without requiring step-by-step direction from management.
Identify problems before they escalate; report issues to management with context, options, and a recommended course of action, not merely a flag that a problem exists.
Build, document, and continuously improve the operating systems, checklists, and standard operating procedures the property runs on.
Staff Supervision and People Management:
Directly manage the Operations Manager and provide senior oversight of junior and mid-level operational staff, including front desk officers, housekeepers, and other facility staff (maintenance, drivers, gardeners, security).
Resolve staff conflicts and operational disputes swiftly, fairly, and with minimal need for management intervention.
Guest Experience and Hospitality Standards:
Own the guest experience end to end, ensuring every apartment, common area, and facility consistently meets luxury hospitality standards.
Personally handle escalated guest complaints, high-stakes requests, and sensitive situations with composure and discretion.
Conduct regular, unannounced inspections of apartments and facilities to a five-star standard, not a checklist minimum.
Translate guest feedback into concrete operational improvements.
Reporting, Budgeting and Administration:
Prepare accurate, well-structured daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports for management.
Monitor operational costs and support budget planning and cost control.
Maintain proper documentation and records relating to operations, maintenance, staffing, and incidents.
Support management with operational planning, forecasting, and strategic decision-making.
Qualifications And Experience
Bachelor's Degree or HND in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
5–8 years' experience in hospitality operations, hotel management, luxury serviced apartments, or short-let/Airbnb management, with at least 2–3 years in a senior or managerial leadership capacity.
Demonstrable experience directly supervising both junior/mid-level staff and facility teams.
Prior exposure to property renovation, remodelling, or construction-adjacent supervision is strongly preferred.
Proven track record of running operations with minimal supervision and taking full ownership of outcomes.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and operational reporting tools.
Candidate Requirements
Must be based in Abuja.
Must be available for full-time, on-site work with flexibility for operational demands outside standard hours, including during the current remodelling period.
Must be ready to take up a senior leadership role with immediate effect and minimal ramp-up time.
