Job Description:
What You Will Do
Own the customer experience from the moment someone reaches out to Regirl through to the point where their question, order, complaint, or issue is properly resolved.
You'll be the person customers interact with most directly, so you'll need to respond quickly, solve problems rather than simply acknowledge them, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
Who we are looking for:
Someone who genuinely enjoys dealing with people and is naturally good at figuring things out. You're comfortable handling a high volume of conversations across WhatsApp, Instagram, phone, and other channels without losing attention to detail. You can deal calmly with an unhappy customer, give a clear answer when you have one, and take ownership when you don't.
Who this role is for:
You are not someone who's happy copying and pasting responses or closing a conversation as soon as you've sent an answer. What sets you apart is that you care about whether the customer's problem was actually solved. You follow up when something is delayed, chase the internal team when an order needs attention, and notice recurring problems that should be fixed rather than handled repeatedly.
Here is the core of why this role exists. Every interaction a customer has with Regirl shapes how they see the brand. A great product can still create a poor customer experience if a question goes unanswered, an order is mishandled, or a complaint gets passed between people without anyone taking ownership.
You'll be responsible for making sure that doesn't happen. You'll respond to customers across our key channels, help them understand our products, support them through their purchase, resolve issues after purchase, and make sure difficult cases are followed through until they're closed.
You'll also be close enough to the customer to notice things the rest of the business may not see. If customers keep asking the same question, struggling with the same part of the ordering process, or complaining about the same issue, we expect you to flag it and help us understand what needs to change.
This role is not for you if you'd rather simply respond to whatever lands in your inbox and move on. It is for you if you get satisfaction from taking a messy customer problem, figuring out what needs to happen, and seeing it through until the customer is genuinely satisfied.
Our environment is structured and performance-driven. We value Speed in how quickly we respond and act, Teamwork in how we work across departments to solve customer issues, Respect in how we treat every customer, Initiative in how we take ownership without waiting to be told, Visibility in how clearly we communicate and track issues, and Excellence in the experience we deliver.
What You Will Own
Respond to customer enquiries across WhatsApp, Instagram, phone, email, and other customer-facing channels.
Help customers understand our products, pricing, availability, ordering process, and delivery options.
Own customer complaints from the first report through to resolution, making sure issues are properly closed rather than simply acknowledged.
Follow up on delayed orders, delivery issues, product concerns, and other unresolved customer requests.
Work closely with Sales, Operations, Styling, Production, and other teams to resolve issues that require internal support.
Recommend the right Regirl products based on what customers are looking for, where appropriate.
Keep accurate records of customer conversations, complaints, feedback, orders, and resolutions.
Identify recurring customer questions and complaints, and flag patterns that could improve our products, processes, or customer experience.
Escalate issues that require management attention while remaining responsible for keeping the customer informed.
Help build and improve the standards, responses, processes, and routines we use to deliver a consistent customer experience.
What You Need to Have
Non-negotiable:
Real, demonstrated experience in customer support, customer service, customer experience, sales support, or a similar customer-facing role.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and naturally with different types of customers.
Comfortable handling customer conversations across WhatsApp, Instagram, phone, and other digital channels.

Job Description:
What You Will Do
You will be responsible for carrying out laboratory and material processing procedures that determine the quality, texture, colour, and finish of our hair products. This includes washing, prepping, texturising, steaming, colouring, neutralising, conditioning, drying, and quality testing.
You will work closely with the production and quality teams to ensure every process is completed accurately and consistently. You will also maintain equipment, prepare materials and chemical solutions, document processes, and ensure the laboratory environment remains clean, organised, and safe.
Who we are looking for:
We are looking for someone who is highly detail oriented, disciplined, and comfortable working with structured processes. You should be able to follow an SOP carefully, measure materials accurately, identify when something is not right, and take action before an issue affects the final product.
You should also be comfortable with repetitive technical work and understand that consistency matters. We want someone who is curious about how materials behave, pays attention to small differences, and takes pride in producing the same quality result repeatedly.
Who this role is for:
This role is for someone who enjoys working with their hands and following technical processes to achieve a specific result. You will be working with hair materials, chemicals, equipment, measurements, and controlled processing conditions, so attention to detail is essential.
The role requires more than simply following instructions. You will need to understand why each step matters, recognise when a process is not going as expected, and communicate issues quickly. A strong Laboratory Technician will notice changes in texture, colour, softness, pattern, or finish and raise them before the product moves to the next stage.
This is not a role for someone who is careless with measurements or skips steps when work gets busy. It is also not for someone who needs constant supervision to complete routine processes. We are looking for someone who can learn our processes, follow them consistently, maintain a high standard, and gradually take greater ownership of the work.
Our environment is structured and performance driven. We value Speed, Teamwork, Respect, Initiative, Visibility, and Excellence, and we expect these qualities to show in how you work, communicate, maintain your station, and take responsibility for your output.
What You Will Own
Execute laboratory processes including washing, prepping, texturising, steaming, colouring, neutralising, conditioning, and drying.
Follow approved SOPs for chemical treatments, processing times, temperatures, equipment use, and hygiene.
Prepare chemical mixtures, baths, and solutions using accurate measurements and specified ratios.
Operate laboratory and production equipment including steamers, dryers, hot water baths, digital scales, mixers, heating tools, and conditioning machines.
Inspect processed hair for texture, pattern, softness, colour accuracy, strength, uniformity, and overall finish.
Identify processing issues and report them promptly before affected products move to the next stage.
Keep laboratory workstations, tools, equipment, and materials clean, organised, and properly maintained.
Maintain accurate records of processes, measurements, materials used, and quality checks.
Monitor the use of chemicals and consumables and flag low stock before it affects production.
Work closely with Production, Quality, Styling, and other teams to maintain a smooth production flow.
Follow all safety, chemical handling, hygiene, and factory procedures consistently.
Contribute ideas that improve process consistency, reduce errors, minimise waste, and improve production efficiency.
What You Need to Have
Non negotiable:
Strong attention to detail and accuracy when working with measurements, materials, and processes.
Ability to follow SOPs and structured procedures consistently.
Good understanding of safe material and chemical handling.
Ability to maintain a clean, organised, and controlled work environment.
Strong observation skills and ability to identify changes or inconsistencies in a process or finished product.
Ability to work effectively in a structured production environment.
Basic proficiency with Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.
Strong communication and ability to work effectively with other teams.

Previous experience in a laboratory, production, manufacturing, quality control, cosmetics, hair, beauty, or related environment.

Experience with quality inspection or batch based production.
Technical, laboratory, science, chemistry, biology, cosmetology, or related educational background.

Job Description
The Earthworks Engineer specializes in soil mechanics, site grading, excavation, and complex ground stabilization operations.
The incumbent takes direct technical ownership of challenging terrain projects, focusing heavily on executing efficient de-watering systems and land reclamation strategies to transform waterlogged or swampy areas into stable, buildable construction sites.
Responsibilities
De-Watering Operations & Water Management:
Design, plan, and supervise comprehensive de-watering systems (wellpoints, deep wells, sump pumping, and cofferdams) for waterlogged and high-water-table sites.
Monitor ground-water movement, control discharge safely, and ensure continuous site dryness to prevent structural settling or soil liquefaction during excavation.
Select, deploy, and maintain appropriate pumping machinery, piping networks, and filtration units to match site-specific hydrological conditions.
Land Reclamation & Site Stabilization:
Spearhead land reclamation initiatives by evaluating soil composition, managing dredging output, and overseeing sand-filling operations.
Implement ground improvement techniques such as surcharging, vibro-compaction, geo-textile installation, and stone columns to stabilize weak swamp foundations.
Supervise heavy earth-moving machinery (excavators, bulldozers, wheel loaders, and compactors) to achieve proper grading, compaction densities, and elevation profiles.
Geotechnical & Surveying Analysis:
Review soil test reports, geological surveys, and topographical data to formulate safe and cost-effective earthworks execution methodologies.
Collaborate closely with surveyors to monitor settlement markers, slope stability, and excavation depth tolerances.
HSE & Quality Assurance Compliance:
Enforce stringent Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) protocols around excavation pits, water bodies, and heavy machinery operation zones.
Ensure full compliance with environmental protection regulations, erosion control standards, and statutory civil engineering codes.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Reporting:
Coordinate daily with site supervisors, project managers, and the General Manager (Technical) during toolbox briefings to align field targets.
Maintain accurate logs of earthwork volumes, fuel consumption, equipment deployment, and daily site progress reports.
Requirements
Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering. Professional registration (e.g., COREN) is an added advantage.
Minimum of 10 years of dedicated civil engineering experience, with a proven, verifiable track record in handling de-watering projects and land reclamation in challenging swampy or waterlogged terrains.
Deep expertise in hydrogeology, soil mechanics, and pump system engineering.
Proficiency in civil engineering design software and earthwork volume calculation tools.
Strong operational leadership, problem-solving skills under adverse weather/site conditions, and attention to safety detail.

Ensure proper waste management, safe disposal protocols, and adherence to site safety guidelines during heavy mechanical lifts and pipe-laying operations.

In-depth knowledge of fluid mechanics, HVAC design, plumbing codes, and industrial utility systems.
Strong project management, problem-solving aptitude, and high safety compliance discipline.

Company Details:
Established in 1951, IOM is the leading inter-governmental organization in the field of migration and works closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners.

With 151 member states, a further 12 states holding observer status and offices in over 100 countries, IOM is ded...read moreicated to promoting humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It does so by providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM works to help ensure the orderly and humane management of migration, to promote international cooperation on migration issues, to assist in the search for practical solutions to migration problems and to provide humanitarian assistance to migrants in need, including refugees and internally displaced people.

The IOM Constitution recognizes the link between migration and economic, social and cultural development, as well as to the right of freedom of movement.

IOM works in the four broad areas of migration management:

Migration and development
Facilitating migration
Regulating migration
Forced migration.
IOM activities that cut across these areas include the promotion of international migration law, policy debate and guidance, protection of migrants' rights, migration health and the gender dimension of migration.

IOM Nigeria commenced activities in 2001 and focused its interventions on counter trafficking activities, migration issues, return and reintegration of stranded migrants especially to Liberia, and Voluntary Returns from abroad.

Job Summary
The Teacher is responsible for assisting the head class teacher in teaching designated class pupils and ensuring that they achieve the highest possible standards of academic work and personal conduct in line with the school vision, mission, values and curriculum.
Core Responsibilities
Be knowledgeable about related subjects and curriculum content
Prepare writing materials, demonstration materials, craft materials, board displays experiment materials, Montessori materials (where applicable) and other learning materials
Make copies of learning materials
Ensure class room is neat and tidy
Prepare interactive white board and laptops for learning
Receive pupils and ensure submission of homework
Record and check daily class attendance. Report absences to class teacher
Support teacher to provide individualized and group teaching to pupils
Teach class in the absence of class teacher
Monitor class activities, check and correct classwork assigned by the class teacher during lessons
Communicate pupils’ progress to the class teacher
Check and ensure pupils are following laid down class routines and procedures
Monitor pupils’ safety within and outside the classroom
Ensure safety of pupils’ belongings
Reconcile minor conflicts amongst pupils and report disciplinary issues to class teacher
Ensure all learning materials are packed up at the end of each lesson and each day
Mark classwork and homework
Take responsibility for the efficient and safe use of learning resources and equipment
Take responsibility for own professional development.

Carry out daily and surprise cash counts, and reconcile POS sales, transfers and bank lodgements

ICAN or ACCA is an advantage
Strong Excel and ERP skills
Integrity, and the confidence to challenge anyone, whatever their seniority
Willingness to move between branches and make unannounced visits

Job Summary
The RMNCAEH Quality of Care (QoC) Mentor will provide routine on-site mentoring, coaching, and technical assistance to health facilities to strengthen the quality of Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, Child, Adolescent Health and Nutrition (RMNCAH+N) services.
The mentor will support facilities to identify quality gaps through data-driven approaches, strengthen adherence to national clinical standards and guidelines, institutionalize quality improvement processes, and enhance service delivery outcomes.
They will conduct quarterly QoC assessment across supported facilities using the 8 standards of car.
Goal
To improve the quality of RMNCAEH and Nutrition services through continuous mentoring, coaching, quality improvement support, and data-driven decision-making at supported health facilities.
Specific Objectives
Strengthen health worker competencies in the delivery of high-impact RMNCAEH and Nutrition interventions.
Improve the use of service delivery data for identification and resolution of quality gaps.
Strengthen Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) practices within supported facilities.
Improve referral and feedback mechanisms for maternal, newborn, child, adolescent health, and nutrition services.
Establish, revitalize, and strengthen functional Quality Improvement Teams (QITs).
Institutionalize continuous quality improvement using recognized QI methodologies and tools.
Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
Routine Mentoring and Coaching of health care workers
The Mentor Will:
Conduct regular facility visits (20 days per month) to provide on-site mentoring and coaching to healthcare providers.
Support providers to effectively implement high-impact interventions in maternal, newborn, child, and adolescent health, including nutrition services
Reinforce compliance with national clinical protocols, standards, and guidelines.
Observe service delivery practices and provide constructive feedback for performance improvement.
Facilitate skills transfer through demonstration, bedside coaching, and case reviews.
Data-Driven Quality Improvement Support
The Mentor Will:
Review facility performance data to identify service delivery and quality improvement gaps.
Support health workers to routinely analyze data from registers, patient records, tally sheets, DHIS2 reports, partographs, maternity registers, child health registers, nutrition registers, and other source documents.
Guide facility teams to use data for evidence-based decision-making and planning.
Track priority quality indicators and support facilities to improve performance.
Quality Improvement (QI) Processes
The Mentor Will:
Support facilities to identify priority quality problems using routine service delivery data.
Facilitate root cause analysis using quality improvement tools including:Five Whys Analysis, Fishbone (Ishikawa) Diagram and Process Mapping
Support facility teams to prioritize identified causes and develop change ideas.
Guide facility teams in the application of the Plan-Do-Study-Act (PDSA) cycle to test and implement solutions.
Monitor progress of improvement projects and document lessons learned and best practices.
Strengthening Quality Improvement Teams (QITs)
The Mentor Will:
Support facilities to inaugurate or revitalize Quality Improvement Teams (QITs).
Orient QIT members on their roles and responsibilities.
Facilitate the development of facility-specific quality improvement plans.
Support QITs to conduct monthly meetings and maintain meeting records.
Review QIT action plans and monitor implementation of agreed actions.
Promote multidisciplinary participation and ownership of quality improvement activities.
Maternal, Newborn, Child, Adolescent Health and Nutrition Support
The Mentor Will:
Provide technical guidance on quality service delivery across RMNCAEH and Nutrition service areas.
Support implementation of interventions aimed at reducing maternal, newborn, and child morbidity and mortality.
Strengthen nutrition assessment, counseling, referral, and follow-up systems.
Promote adherence to standards for ANC, labor and delivery, postnatal care, newborn care, child health, adolescent health, and nutrition services.
Referral System Strengthening
The Mentor Will:
Provide technical support to strengthen two-way referral systems.
Ensure proper documentation of referrals and feedback mechanisms between referring and receiving facilities.
Review referral registers and referral outcomes during mentoring visits. Support facilities to identify and address referral bottlenecks affecting service quality and continuity of care.
Infection Prevention and Control (IPC)
The Mentor Will:
Assess compliance with IPC standards and protocols.
Provide practical coaching on hand hygiene, environmental cleaning, decontamination, sterilization, and waste management.
Support facilities to establish and maintain proper healthcare waste segregation and disposal practices.
Identify IPC gaps and support implementation of corrective actions.
Promote availability and appropriate use of IPC commodities and personal protective equipment.
Documentation, Reporting and Follow-Up
The Mentor Will:
Develop mentoring visit reports with documented observations, recommendations, and action points.
Maintain records of mentorship sessions, QI activities, and facility performance improvements.
Share feedback with facility management and relevant stakeholders.
Monitor implementation of agreed action plans during subsequent visits.
Highlight best practices, success stories, lessons learned, and persistent challenges requiring escalation.
Deliverables
The Mentor Shall Produce:
Monthly facility mentorship reports.
Facility-specific quality improvement projects.
Root cause analysis reports for identified quality gap and improvement tracking records.
Monthly QIT meeting reports and attendance records.
Quarterly QoC Assessment Report
Required Qualifications
The RMNCAEH Quality of Care (QoC) Mentor shall possess the following minimum qualifications, professional experience, technical competencies, and personal attributes:
Educational Qualifications:
Bachelor’s Degree in nursing, Midwifery, Medicine, Public Health, Community Health, or another relevant health-related discipline from a recognized institution.
A master’s degree in public health, Nursing, Midwifery, Health Services Management, or a related field will be an added advantage.
Valid professional registration and current practicing licence with the relevant regulatory body, where applicable.
Professional Experience:
At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in RMNCAEH, primary healthcare, quality improvement, or health systems strengthening.
At least 3 years of demonstrated experience providing facility-level mentoring, coaching, supportive supervision, or technical assistance to healthcare providers.
Demonstrated experience working with primary healthcare facilities and health workers, preferably within Nigeria.
Experience supporting the implementation of maternal, newborn, child, adolescent health and nutrition interventions.
Experience conducting Quality of Care assessments using national or recognized QoC standards and assessment tools.
Demonstrated experience in establishing, strengthening, or supporting Quality Improvement Teams (QITs) and facility-level quality improvement initiatives.
Experience applying quality improvement methodologies, particularly Plan-Do-Study-Act (PDSA) cycles.
Demonstrated experience using QI tools such as Five Whys, Fishbone/Ishikawa analysis, process mapping, and other root-cause analysis approaches.
Experience supporting health facilities to use routine health information and service delivery data for quality improvement and decision-making.
Experience in Infection Prevention and Control (IPC), referral systems, clinical standards, and adherence to national guidelines.
Previous experience working with State Ministries of Health, SPHCDA, LGAs, development partners, or other health-sector stakeholders will be an advantage.
Technical Competencies
The mentor should demonstrate sound knowledge and practical competence in:
RMNCAEH and Nutrition service delivery at primary and secondary healthcare levels.
National clinical standards, guidelines, protocols, and quality-of-care requirements.
Quality Improvement methodologies and tools.
Facility-level QoC assessment and performance improvement.
Data quality assessment, data analysis, interpretation, and use.
DHIS2 and other routine health information.

Jhpiego offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive employee benefits package.

The Network Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, security, and reliability of the organisation's network infrastructure across all sites. Working knowledge of Sophos Firewall administration (or equivalent enterprise firewall platforms).
Solid understanding of VLANs, IP addressing/subnetting, and wireless Access Point management.
Familiarity with vulnerability management concepts and experience collaborating with a SOC or security team on CVE remediation.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills under operational pressure.
Good documentation habits and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently across multiple sites while maintaining clear communication with the Technical Lead.
Security-conscious mindset with an understanding of network hardening best practices.
Effective collaborator — works cross-functionally with SOC and Datacenter Engineering without duplicating effort.

The Legal Manager & Group Company Secretary will serve as the

law and business

Corporate Governance & Board Secretariat

Maintain statutory registers, corporate records and governance documentation.
Advise the Board and management on corporate governance requirements and directors' responsibilities.
Coordinate the appointment and onboarding of directors and senior governance officers.
Maintain consistent governance standards across Afrihood Nigeria, its subsidiaries and project SPVs.
Ensure appropriate approvals, delegated authorities and reserved matters are observed across the Group.
Transactions & Project Structuring
Lead the legal structuring and documentation of property acquisitions, development transactions and joint ventures.
Draft, review and negotiate land acquisition agreements, JV agreements, development agreements, leases, sales documentation and other commercial contracts.
Conduct and coordinate legal due diligence on land, projects, counterparties and transactions.
Support the establishment and governance of project SPVs and other investment structures.
Work closely with investment, finance, property and project teams from transaction origination through financial close and execution.
Develop standard legal structures and documentation that can be efficiently deployed across Afrihood's Project CEO network.

Support institutional debt, private capital, project finance and investment transactions.
Review and negotiate facility agreements, security documents, guarantees, trust arrangements, escrow structures and investment agreements.
Coordinate transaction documentation with financiers, investors, trustees, external counsel and other professional advisers.
Ensure financing obligations, conditions precedent, covenants and security requirements are properly documented, tracked and managed.
Support the legal structuring of capital deployed across Afrihood's Nigerian project portfolio.
Property, Title & Development
Oversee title verification, perfection, registration and other property-related legal processes.
Coordinate land documentation and relevant government interfaces.
Identify title, encumbrance, contractual and development risks before Afrihood commits capital to projects.
Maintain proper legal records for Afrihood's property and development portfolio.
Establish standard legal frameworks and documentation for projects originated through Afrihood's Project CEO network.
Coordinate external property lawyers, surveyors and other professional advisers where required.

Build a legal and governance framework capable of supporting multiple developments and project companies across Nigeria.
Standardise key agreements, approval processes and legal documentation across the Afrihood platform.
Establish clear legal relationships between Afrihood Nigeria, its subsidiaries, project SPVs and Project CEOs.

one disciplined Nigerian development institution
.

commercially intelligent lawyer and institution builder with approximately 5–10 years of post-call experience

Corporate and commercial transactions.
Real estate development and property law.
Joint ventures, acquisitions and investment structures.
Project finance, institutional financing or secured lending transactions.
Corporate governance and company secretarial practice.
Board and committee administration.
Contract drafting and negotiation.
Legal due diligence and transaction management.
Regulatory compliance and corporate restructuring.
Working with senior executives, investors, financial institutions and external counsel.

real estate developer, infrastructure company, investment firm, financial institution or leading commercial law firm

You understand that the role of an excellent in-house lawyer is not merely to identify why something cannot be done, but to understand the commercial objective, identify the risks and help structure a responsible way to achieve it.
You should be comfortable moving between a Board meeting, a financing transaction, a land acquisition, a Project CEO agreement and a regulatory issue without losing attention to detail.
You must possess
exceptional integrity, discretion and judgement
. You will have access to some of Afrihood's most sensitive corporate, financial, investment and Board information.

build the legal and governance architecture of an institution
, rather than simply manage an existing legal department.

5–10 years post-call experience.

Performance of external law firms and recovery partners against targets.

Job Title: Senior Accountant, Serviced Apartments Hospitality, Abuja
Job Description:
Our client is a well-established, premier hospitality company specialising in furnished and serviced apartments in Abuja. With a legacy spanning more than twenty years, the property has built a strong reputation for accommodation and guest services to business travellers, health tourists, vacationers, families, and conference organisers.
The business already has an established operating structure and a functioning finance team in place. It is now entering a phase focused on sharpening commercial strategy, strengthening financial governance, and building the systems and insight required to scale sustainably. This is a senior management position for an experienced finance leader who can operate well beyond routine accounting; someone who brings strategic financial management, commercial judgement, and leadership to the function.
WHAT THEY STAND FOR
Integrity and accountability, maintaining clean financial records, transparent reporting and strong controls.
Excellence as a standard of accurate, timely and reliable financial reporting and decision support.
Commercial discipline, controlling costs and optimising margins without compromising guest experience.
Sustainable growth, ensuring the business has the financial strategy, visibility and controls required to scale.
THE ROLE DESCRIPTION
-
The Senior Accountant is a senior management position and a strategic partner to the General Manager and the wider leadership team. Rather than performing day-to-day bookkeeping, the role directs and leads the existing finance and accounts team, providing financial strategy, commercial insight, governance and decision support across the business. The successful candidate will own financial planning and analysis, revenue and profitability strategy, cash and working capital management, risk and controls, and statutory compliance, shaping the financial direction of the business, not just reporting on it. The role works closely with the General Manager, ownership, and operational department heads to drive performance, protect value and position the business for sustainable growth.
KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
STRATEGIC FINANCIAL LEADERSHIP & BUSINESS PARTNERING
Serve as a strategic finance partner to the General Manager and senior management team, translating financial data into actionable business insight.
Lead development of the property's financial strategy in support of long-term growth and profitability objectives.
Provide financial input into major operational, commercial and investment decisions, including pricing strategy, capital expenditure and expansion opportunities.
Advise ownership and management on the financial implications of strategic initiatives, new revenue lines and operational changes.
Champion a culture of financial discipline, accountability and commercial awareness across all departments.
FINANCIAL PLANNING, ANALYSIS & PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT
Direct the preparation of monthly management accounts, board packs and performance reports, ensuring accuracy and strategic relevance.
Lead financial planning and analysis (FP&A) activity, including scenario planning, sensitivity analysis and long-range forecasting.
Analyse revenue, cost and margin performance across accommodation, F&B, events and ancillary revenue streams, identifying trends and opportunities.
Own the annual budgeting process end to end, working with department heads to build realistic, growth-oriented budgets.
Present financial performance and key business insights to ownership and senior management, highlighting risks, opportunities and recommended actions.
REVENUE STRATEGY & COMMERCIAL PERFORMANCE
Partner with the General Manager and front-office/revenue teams on pricing strategy, rate structures and revenue management to optimise occupancy and RevPAR.
Oversee reconciliation of PMS, POS and accounting records to safeguard revenue integrity across all guest-facing departments.
Evaluate profitability of accommodation, F&B, events and ancillary services, and recommend strategies to grow high-margin revenue streams.
Provide commercial and financial analysis to support corporate and long-stay contract negotiations.
Identify and address revenue leakage, discounting patterns and pricing anomalies at a strategic level.
COST LEADERSHIP & PROFITABILITY MANAGEMENT
Set the framework for cost management across the business, balancing cost efficiency with guest experience and service standards.
Lead departmental cost reviews, identifying structural cost-saving and efficiency opportunities.
Oversee procurement and inventory strategy to ensure cost-effective purchasing without compromising quality.
Drive profitability analysis across revenue and cost centres, guiding management decisions on resource allocation.
Benchmark cost and margin performance against industry standards to identify improvement opportunities.
CASH FLOW, TREASURY & WORKING CAPITAL MANAGEMENT
Oversee cash flow planning and treasury management to ensure the business maintains healthy liquidity.
Manage banking relationships and oversee financing arrangements where applicable.
Monitor working capital, including receivables, payables and inventory, to optimize cash conversion.
Provide oversight of the accounts payable and receivable functions, ensuring strong collections and payment discipline.
Advise management on funding requirements for capital projects and expansion initiatives.
GOVERNANCE, RISK & INTERNAL CONTROLS
Design, implement and continuously strengthen the internal control environment across revenue, expenditure, procurement, inventory and cash.
Lead risk identification and mitigation across financial and operational risk areas.
Ensure appropriate segregation of duties, approval hierarchies and financial policies are upheld across the business.
Oversee investigation of significant variances, control breaches or irregularities, and lead corrective action.
Ensure the business maintains audit-ready financial records at all times.
TEAM LEADERSHIP & FINANCE FUNCTION DEVELOPMENT
Lead, mentor and develop the existing finance and accounts team, building capability and succession depth.
Set clear performance expectations, review team output and drive continuous improvement in accuracy and turnaround.
Establish and maintain finance policies, procedures and standard operating processes across the function.
Foster collaboration between finance and operational departments (front office, F&B, housekeeping, procurement, HR).
Represent the finance function in senior management meetings and cross-functional initiatives.
TAX, STATUTORY COMPLIANCE & AUDIT
Ensure full compliance with applicable Nigerian tax and statutory requirements, overseeing timely filing and remittance.
Own the relationship with external auditors, tax consultants and regulatory bodies.
Lead year-end audit processes, ensuring timely completion and resolution of audit findings.
Maintain financial records and reporting in line with applicable accounting standards.
Monitor regulatory developments relevant to the hospitality sector and advise management accordingly.
SYSTEMS, TECHNOLOGY & PROCESS TRANSFORMATION
Drive the integration and optimisation of PMS, POS and accounting systems to improve reporting accuracy and efficiency.
Champion automation of repetitive financial processes to free capacity for higher-value analysis.
Develop finance dashboards and reporting tools that give management real-time visibility into performance.
Lead process-improvement initiatives to enhance the speed, accuracy and reliability of financial information.
Document and institutionalise finance policies and procedures to ensure consistency as the business scales.
QUALIFICATIONS/ EXPERIENCE/ KNOWLEDGE
ROLE REQUIREMENTS
Minimum of 12–15 years' progressive finance/accounting experience, including significant experience at a senior management level.
At least 5–7 years in a Senior Accountant, Head of Finance, Finance Manager or equivalent leadership role, with direct oversight of a finance team.
Demonstrable experience in hospitality, hotels, serviced apartments or another high-volume, multi-revenue-stream service environment is strongly preferred.
Proven track record of strategic financial leadership and business partnering, driving commercial performance rather than purely transactional accounting.
Strong experience in financial planning & analysis (FP&A), budgeting, forecasting and cost management at a senior level.
Experience presenting financial performance and strategic recommendations to senior management, ownership or a board.
Sound understanding of hospitality revenue models, PMS/POS systems and multi-department revenue reconciliation.
Strong knowledge of treasury, cash flow management and working capital optimisation.
Strong understanding of Nigerian tax and statutory compliance requirements.
Demonstrated experience leading, developing and managing a finance team.
Proficiency in accounting software, financial modelling and Microsoft Excel.
Strong strategic thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills, balanced with attention to operational detail.
High level of integrity, accountability and professional judgement.
Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
EDUCATION & PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
A good first degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
A professional accounting qualification such as ICAN or ACCA is required.
An MBA, CFA, or other relevant postgraduate/strategic finance qualification is an advantage.
Relevant hospitality finance or senior finance leadership experience will be a strong advantage.

Job Summary
The Procurement Officer is responsible for executing field procurement, supplier engagement and market intelligence activities within assigned locations (Kano and Sagamu). The role sources agro-commodities such as cashew, soybeans, sesame, maize, shea nut, and other relevant agricultural commodities (within approved price and quality parameters), engages suppliers, aggregators and buying agents, gathers market price and availability information, coordinates loading and deliveries, liaises with Quality Control on inspection and acceptance, tracks contracted versus delivered volumes, and submits daily procurement reports, in support of the Procurement Supervisor and the wider procurement function.
Job Details
Sourcing within Approved Price and Quality Parameters
Source commodities from farmers, aggregators and suppliers strictly within approved price bands and quality/grading specifications.
Identify and flag off-specification offers or pricing deviations, escalating exceptions beyond approved limits to the Procurement Supervisor.
Supplier, Aggregator and Buying Agent Engagement
Engage and maintain productive working relationships with suppliers, aggregators and buying agents within the assigned location.
Communicate buying requirements, price updates and quality standards clearly to the supply base to sustain a reliable pipeline.
Market Intelligence and Price Monitoring
Collect and report market price trends, commodity availability and competitor buying activity within the assigned location.
Provide timely, accurate market intelligence to support pricing and buying decisions.
Loading and Supplier Delivery Coordination
Coordinate loading schedules with suppliers, transporters and logistics/warehouse teams to ensure timely delivery of purchased commodities.
Monitor in-transit deliveries and promptly resolve loading or dispatch issues.
Quality Control Liaison
Liaise with the Quality Control team to ensure timely inspection, grading and acceptance of purchased commodities.
Follow up on rejected or queried consignments to ensure prompt resolution with suppliers.
Contracted and Delivered Volume Tracking
Maintain accurate records of contracted quantities against actual volumes delivered per supplier and location.
Promptly escalate shortfalls, delays or over-deliveries to the Procurement Supervisor.
Daily Procurement Reporting
Prepare and submit accurate daily reports covering purchases, prices, volumes, supplier engagement and market observations.
Ensure reports are submitted within the required timeline to support supervisory review and decision-making.
Requirements
HND/B.Sc. in any discipline; a background in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Business Administration, or a related field is an advantage.
Relevant professional certification is an added advantage.
Familiarity with commodity buying and grading practices, particularly for agro-commodities, is an advantage.
Minimum of 1-3 years' experience in commodity procurement, supplier management, market dynamics, quality requirements and the respective value chains.
Prior experience working within the assigned location (Kano or Sagamu) is an advantage.

The role opens shipment files following contract confirmation, coordinates NXP, certificates of origin, phytosanitary and inspection documentation, works closely with the Shipping Team, clearing agents and relevant authorities, tracks vessel bookings, cut-off dates and container readiness, coordinates bills of lading and buyer documentation, and escalates documentation delays immediately, in support of the Head of Business and the wider commercial function.
Job Details
Shipment File Initiation
Open shipment files promptly following contract confirmation, capturing buyer, contract, product and shipment details accurately.
Ensure each shipment file is properly structured and tracked from opening through to closure.
Export Documentation Coordination
Coordinate the preparation and processing of NXP forms, certificates of origin, phytosanitary certificates and inspection documentation for each shipment.
Ensure all export documentation complies with regulatory requirements and buyer/contract specifications.
Shipping Team, Clearing Agent and Authority Liaison
Work closely with the Shipping Team, clearing agents and relevant regulatory authorities (e.g., Customs, NAFDAC, NAQS) to ensure smooth export clearance.
Build and maintain effective working relationships with agents and authorities to expedite processing and resolve issues.
Vessel Booking, Cut-off and Container Readiness Tracking
Track vessel bookings, cut-off dates and container readiness for all active shipments, coordinating with Shipping and Operations to ensure timelines are met.
Proactively flag and address risks to vessel/cut-off schedules
Bills of Lading and Buyer Documentation Coordination
Coordinate the preparation, review and dispatch of bills of lading and other buyer-required documentation for each shipment.
Ensure documentation is accurate, complete and dispatched within timelines required for buyer payment/customs clearance at destination.
Documentation Delay Escalation
Immediately escalate documentation delays, bottlenecks or compliance issues that could affect vessel timelines or contract fulfilment to the Head of Business.
Propose and implement mitigation actions to minimise the impact of delays.
Requirements
B.Sc./HND in Business Administration, International Trade, Shipping/Logistics, or a related field.
Membership of a relevant shipping/freight/trade professional body (e.g., Institute of Chartered Shipbrokers) is an advantage.
Strong working knowledge of Nigerian export procedures, INCOTERMS, and export documentation requirements.
Minimum of 6-8 years' experience in export/shipping operations, including significant experience managing agro-commodity export documentation and vessel coordination, with a track record of meeting contract and vessel timelines.

What You'll do:
Payroll Processing (40%)
Support the preparation and processing of payroll for assigned Cellulant Group entities.
Collect, validate and consolidate payroll inputs including employee changes, allowances, deductions and other payroll adjustments.
Assist with payroll reconciliations and verification of payroll data before processing.
Support the preparation of statutory deductions, filings and remittances including KRA, NSSF, SHA and other applicable statutory requirements.
Maintain accurate payroll records and supporting documentation.
Assist in identifying payroll discrepancies and follow through on resolution with guidance from the relevant team members.
Support payroll system updates, testing and process improvement initiatives.
Payroll Administration (35%)
Respond to routine employee payroll queries and escalate more complex matters where necessary.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date payroll records and documentation.
Prepare regular payroll reports and reconciliations for review.
Support the provision of payroll and headcount information required for budgeting and forecasting.
Assist with tracking People & Culture budget utilisation against approved budgets.
Support payroll audits by preparing required documentation and validating payroll information.
Work with People & Culture and Finance colleagues to resolve payroll discrepancies and ensure accurate payroll information.
Benefits Administration (15%)
Support the administration of employee benefits including health insurance, retirement plans and other company benefits.
Assist with employee enrolments, benefit changes and exits.
Respond to routine employee questions relating to benefits and eligibility.
Liaise with benefits providers on routine administrative matters and follow up on outstanding requests.
Maintain accurate employee benefits information within the HRIS and other relevant systems.
Support benefits reconciliations and verification of provider invoices.
Handle employee and benefits information in accordance with applicable data protection requirements.
Payroll & People Analytics (10%)
Support the preparation of regular and ad-hoc payroll and people reports.
Assist in analysing payroll costs, headcount, employee movements and other workforce metrics.
Maintain and update payroll and people dashboards.
Conduct routine data checks and reconciliations to support the accuracy of people data.
Assist with preparing workforce information required by People & Culture and business stakeholders.

Requirements:

Recent graduate or early-career professional with an interest in developing a career in payroll, HR operations or people analytics.
Basic understanding of payroll, accounting, HR administration or statutory compliance is an advantage.
Good numerical and analytical skills.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas and basic data analysis. Knowledge of Pivot Tables and lookup functions is an advantage.
Exposure to HRIS, payroll or accounting systems through employment, internship or academic work is an advantage.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Job Description:
Locations:
Oredo and Ikpoba Okha, Edo
Reports To: Lead, Onboarding
Work Mode: Outsourced and Hybrid
Job Purpose
The Data Entry Officer ensures that customer accounts, product catalogs, inventory records, and pricing data are accurately entered and maintained within the Moniebook platform.
Working closely with Onboarding Specialists and Account Managers, you keep data clean and ready from day one, enabling fast go-lives, reliable reporting, and a smooth experience for every retail customer. Success is measured by accuracy rates, turnaround time, and your contribution to a scalable, error-free operational foundation.
Key Responsibilities
Data Entry & Record Management:
Input, update, and maintain merchant data, including product catalogues, SKUs, pricing, inventory levels, and customer profiles.
Process bulk data imports from spreadsheets and CSV files, validating format and completeness before upload.
Ensure all records adhere to Moniebook's data standards and naming conventions.
Onboarding Data Support:
Prepare merchant accounts ahead of onboarding by populating required product, inventory, and configuration data within agreed timelines.
Review merchant-submitted data templates for errors or missing fields and follow up to resolve gaps before entry.
Support the setup of catalogue structures, tax configurations, and payment settings as directed by the Onboarding team.
Data Validation & Quality Assurance:
Conduct checks to identify and correct errors, duplicates, or outdated records.
Cross-reference data across spreadsheets, CRM, and POS backend to ensure consistency.
Flag and document data anomalies, routing them to the appropriate team for resolution.
Process & Documentation:
Maintain accurate records of data entry activities, import logs, and correction history in the CRM.
Document common errors and resolutions to build a shared knowledge base and reduce repeat mistakes.
Identify recurring workflow bottlenecks and recommend improvements to the Operations lead.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Fulfil ad-hoc data requests from Onboarding Specialists, Account Managers, and Support teams within SLA windows.
Coordinate with internal teams to gather missing customer data without delaying onboarding timelines.
What Success Looks Like
99%+ data entry accuracy across merchant account builds and catalogue uploads.
Zero go-live delays attributable to data readiness.
All ad-hoc data requests fulfilled within defined SLA windows
Open task backlog kept below 5% at any given time.
Achieve >4.5+ average rating score from Onboarding Specialists and Account Managers on data quality and turnaround.
Qualifications
1-3 years in data entry, data operations, or a similar role — preferably in SaaS, retail tech, or fintech.
Must have completed NYSC or possess a valid exemption/exclusion certificate.
Exceptional attention to detail with a track record of high accuracy across large data volumes.
Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (data cleaning, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, basic formulas).
Familiarity with CRM platforms or POS/back-office SaaS tools.
Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Preferred:
Experience with bulk CSV imports, data migration, or catalogue management in a SaaS context.
Exposure to retail operations, inventory systems, or point-of-sale platforms.
Experience supporting an onboarding, implementation, or customer success team.
The candidate should be based in Edo State - Oredo and Ikpoba Okha
About You
You're obsessively detail-oriented and take genuine pride in clean, accurate data.
You're process-driven but proactive, you follow workflows and flag problems before they escalate.
You're a team player who understands that your work sits at the heart of the customer journey.
You're calm under pressure and can handle high volumes without cutting corners.
You're tech-savvy and always looking for smarter, faster ways to work.

Job Description:
About the Role
The Team Lead, Systems Administration is a senior individual contributor who also leads the IT infrastructure team tactically.
This role is responsible for both the hands-on delivery of complex systems work and the orchestration of team priorities, standards, and output quality.
The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in networking, cloud infrastructure, security, and automation with the leadership capability to coach a team, enforce SOPs, and drive measurable operational excellence, including leveraging AI tools to optimise how the team works.
This role sits at the Team Lead level in Moniepoint's Talent Architecture. Success is defined not only by personal technical output, but by the team's consistent performance and delivery against infrastructure-wide targets.
Scope & Decision Horizon:
Leads the IT infrastructure team tactically. Success is the orchestration of people and priorities to ensure the team's immediate output aligns with the broader roadmap.
Principal Duties and Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Operations:
Lead, coordinate, and coach a team of Systems Administrators, ensuring consistent output quality and adherence to SOPs.
Manage team workload, prioritise tasks across competing demands, and ensure SLA compliance across all infrastructure functions.
Conduct regular 1:1s, deliver direct and specific performance feedback, and actively develop team members' technical skills.
Design and enforce team workflows and escalation paths, ensuring quality is consistent regardless of who executes the task.
Own team-level metrics: system uptime (99.9%+), ticket SLAs, incident response times, and end-user satisfaction.
Identify gaps in team capability or process and proactively close them through training, tooling, or workflow redesign.
Infrastructure Management:
Design, implement, and maintain a robust IT infrastructure, including servers and virtualisation platforms (Proxmox).
Administer and optimise Windows Server, Linux systems, and hybrid cloud infrastructures.
Maintain comprehensive system documentation, network diagrams, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Plan and execute system upgrades with minimal downtime; optimise for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
Cloud & Network Infrastructure:
Design, deploy, and manage cloud network environments across GCP, OCI, and Azure, Outpost, including VPCs, subnets, peering, firewall rules, and private connectivity.
Administer and optimise BGP routing policies, virtual routers (vRTF), and F5 load balancers across the enterprise network and cloud environments.
Configure, manage, and troubleshoot enterprise networking infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points).
Implement and maintain network security protocols, VLANs, VPNs, and network segmentation across on-premise and cloud environments.
Manage DNS, DHCP, Directory as a Service, and other core network services.
Monitor network performance, analyse bandwidth utilisation, and implement QoS policies.
AI Tools & Workflow Automation:
Manage, maintain, and evaluate AI tools used across the IT and infrastructure function, ensuring reliability, access control, and appropriate use.
Build and maintain automation workflows using n8n and similar platforms to optimise repetitive operational processes.
Design and implement AI-assisted workflows for network deployment, incident triage, and infrastructure monitoring.
Coach team members on responsible AI integration, when to use AI tools, how to validate outputs, and where human review is required.
Identify opportunities to reduce manual toil through intelligent automation and continuously improve the team's automation capabilities.
Telephony & Unified Communications:
Administer and maintain the xCALLY PBX platform, including call routing, IVR configuration, queue management, and agent provisioning.
Troubleshoot telephony incidents end-to-end: SIP trunks, PBX dial plans, voice quality, and carrier integration.
Coordinate with ISPs and telecom carriers to ensure uptime and quality of voice services across all sites.
Automation & Scripting:
Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to eliminate repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency.
Utilise Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Ansible) for consistent and scalable infrastructure deployment.
Build and maintain monitoring and alerting solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, and Nagios.
Document automation and tooling clearly enough for an Associate-level team member to execute independently.
Security & Compliance:
Implement and enforce IT security policies, access controls, and data protection measures across on-premise and cloud environments.
Manage endpoint security solutions, patch management, and privileged access management.
Manage user authentication systems, including SSO, MFA, and identity governance.
Lead incident response: manage security events, conduct Root Cause Analyses (RCA), and implement permanent fixes.
User Endpoint & Technical Support:
Oversee onboarding and offboarding procedures, ensuring seamless first-day experiences and complete account lifecycle management.
Administer Google Workspace, including user provisioning, group management, Drive policies, and app integrations.
Manage MDM solutions for corporate devices across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android.
Provide or oversee expert-level L2/L3 support, ensuring timely resolution and minimal user disruption.
Manage IT asset inventory, lifecycle, and procurement coordination.
Requirements
Education & Experience:
Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of proven experience in systems administration, infrastructure, or network engineering roles.
At least 2 years of formal or informal team leadership, including coaching, delegation, and performance feedback.
Relevant industry certifications (CompTIA, Cisco, Microsoft, GCP/Azure/OCI cloud, Linux) are highly desirable, but not compulsory.
Technical Skills:
Advanced proficiency in Active Directory / Directory as a Service (e.g., JumpCloud); Linux/Unix administration (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian).
Cloud networking expertise across GCP, OCI, and Azure: VPCs, subnets, load balancers, private service connect, VPN gateways, and cloud firewall management.
Deep understanding of TCP/IP, BGP routing protocols, switching, VLANs, and enterprise network architecture across data centre and WAN environments.
Hands-on experience with virtual routers (vRTF), F5 load balancers, and enterprise networking equipment (Cisco, Ubiquiti).
Virtualisation experience with Proxmox; data centre operations including rack and stack, power, cooling, and structured cabling.
Experience administering xCALLY PBX or equivalent enterprise telephony/unified communications platforms.
Proficiency in scripting: Python, PowerShell, Bash; experience with Ansible and Terraform.
Hands-on experience with n8n or equivalent workflow automation platforms for building and managing operational automations.
Experience managing AI tools within an IT environment, including access control, integration, and responsible use governance.
Experience with monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Nagios, PRTG) and endpoint/MDM management platforms.
Proficiency in Google Workspace administration: user and group management, Drive, Gmail, Meet, and third-party app integrations.
Advanced infosec tooling experience (e.g., CrowdStrike); knowledge of Disaster Recovery protocols and DR drills.
Experience with Jira Service Management; understanding of SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs.

Customer-obsessed: identifies and permanently resolves recurring pain points, not just individual tickets.

The Sales Lead – Invoice & Reverse Factoring is responsible for driving business growth by acquiring and managing enterprise clients for the company’s financing solutions. Reporting to the Head of Sales, the role manages the full sales cycle, from prospecting and closing deals to growing client relationships. The Sales Lead is accountable for meeting revenue and transaction targets, increasing platform adoption, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver an excellent customer experience and achieve the company’s commercial goals.
Key Responsibilities
Revenue delivery: Achieve assigned revenue, financing volume, and client acquisition targets through consistent business development and sales execution.
Business growth: Drive sustainable growth by increasing the adoption and transaction volumes of Invoice & Reverse Factoring solutions on the company’s platform.
Opportunity generation: Identify, qualify, and pursue invoice financing opportunities across target industries and strategic market segments.
a
Business development: Develop and execute commercial strategies that expand the company’s market presence and strengthen its position within the supply chain finance ecosystem.
Pipeline management: Build, manage, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline with qualified prospects to consistently achieve and exceed commercial performance targets.
Client acquisition: Prospect, qualify, and onboard new anchor clients and vendors onto the company’s platform, ensuring a consistent pipeline of qualified business opportunities.
Solution selling: Assess clients\' working capital needs and recommend tailored Invoice & Reverse Factoring solutions that address their financing challenges.

Commercial collaboration: Partner with the Growth Marketing team to convert qualified leads into active customers.

Onboarding coordination: Coordinate cross-functional onboarding activities to ensure an efficient and positive customer journey.
Pipeline management: Maintain an accurate and healthy sales pipeline by managing CRM records, tracking opportunities, and monitoring conversion rates.
Sales reporting: Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales reports, forecasts, and commercial performance updates.
Performance monitoring: Monitor revenue performance, pipeline health, financing transaction volumes, and sales conversion metrics to achieve business targets.
Commercial communication: Maintain regular communication with the Head of Sales regarding pipeline performance, business opportunities, forecasts, and commercial risks.
Compliance & governance: Ensure all sales activities, commercial engagements, and client transactions comply with the company’s internal policies, regulatory requirements, and governance standards.
Key Deliverables & Success Measures

Growth in Invoice & Reverse Factoring transaction volumes.
Successful acquisition of new anchor clients and vendors.
High conversion rate from qualified opportunities to closed deals.
Increased repeat invoice trading and client retention.
Well-maintained commercial pipeline with accurate forecasting.
Strong executive-level client relationships resulting in long-term commercial partnerships.
Timely and accurate sales reporting and CRM management.
Effective collaboration with Customer Success, Product, Risk, Marketing, and Operations teams.

Minimum of 3-5 years\' experience in Enterprise Sales, Business Development, Corporate Banking, Trade Finance, Supply Chain Finance, Fintech, or Financial Services.
Demonstrated success in consistently achieving or exceeding commercial and revenue targets.
Experience selling B2B financial products or enterprise technology solutions.
Strong understanding of corporate sales processes and consultative selling techniques.
Existing professional network within finance, procurement, manufacturing, FMCG, healthcare, logistics, or related industries is an added advantage.

Job Description:
Department: Finance
Reports To: Chief Executive Officer / Designated Executive
Job Level: Mid- Senior Level
Role Summary
The Senior Finance Officer will take ownership of financial reporting, budgeting, cash flow management, revenue and collections reconciliation, statutory compliance, financial controls and business performance analysis.
The individual will ensure that the financial performance of the business is accurately tracked and reported.
This is a hands-on role that combines day-to-day financial management with business partnering and finance leadership.
The successful candidate must be capable of working independently, strengthening financial discipline and developing scalable processes to support business growth.
Key Responsibilities
Finance Leadership and Business Support:
Lead and coordinate the Finance function.
Provide management with timely financial information, analysis and recommendations.
Translate business objectives into budgets, financial plans and measurable financial targets.
Advise management on cash flow, profitability, cost management, investments and financial risks.
Participate in management and business performance meetings.
Support strategic planning, investor due diligence, fundraising and other corporate finance initiatives.
Develop the structure, policies and processes required for a scalable Finance function.
Coordinate the activities of junior finance employees and external financial advisers where applicable
Financial Reporting and Management Accounts:
Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly and annual management accounts
Produce income statements, balance sheets and cash flow statements.
Ensure all transactions are accurately recorded in the appropriate ledgers
Analyze revenue, expenditure, margins and profitability.
Prepare financial performance dashboards and management reports.
Conduct budget-versus-actual analysis and investigate significant variances.
Ensure the integrity, completeness and accuracy of all financial records.
Maintain the general ledger and all supporting accounting schedules.
Revenue, Collections and Receivables Management:
Maintain financial oversight of expected and actual collections.
Monitor outstanding receivables, repayment performance, ageing balances and collection efficiency.
Prepare and review daily, weekly and monthly collection reports.
Reconcile collections received through bank accounts, payment platforms and other collection channels.
Work with the Collections, Operations and Portfolio teams to investigate and resolve discrepancies.
Develop and enforce controls for revenue recognition, receivables management and debt recovery.
Escalate significant collection shortfalls, overdue balances and portfolio risks to management.
Provide financial analysis to support improvements in collections and recovery performance.
Ensure that revenue recorded is complete, accurate and supported by appropriate documentation.
Treasury, Cash Flow and Working Capital:
Take ownership of cash flow planning and liquidity management.
Prepare and regularly update short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts.
Monitor daily bank balances, expected inflows and upcoming financial obligations.
Recommend payment priorities based on available cash, contractual obligations and business needs.
Ensure approved payments are accurately processed and appropriately documented.
Perform timely bank reconciliations and resolve all reconciling items.
Maintain relationships with banks, payment providers and other financial institutions.
Identify potential cash flow gaps and recommend appropriate mitigating actions.
Develop initiatives to improve working capital and shorten the cash conversion cycle.
Monitor restricted funds, operational accounts and other designated financial resources.
Budgeting, Forecasting and Financial Planning:
Lead the annual budgeting process
Coordinate budget inputs from departmental and business unit heads.
Prepare periodic financial forecasts based on current operational and financial performance.
Monitor departmental expenditure against approved budgets.
Review financial assumptions and ensure budgets align with business priorities.
Develop financial models for new products, partnerships, projects and expansion opportunities.
Conduct profitability, scenario, sensitivity and cost-benefit analyses.
Identify cost-optimization opportunities without compromising operational effectiveness.
Track performance against approved financial targets and recommend corrective actions.
Support long-term financial planning and resource-allocation decisions.
Accounts Payable and Expense Management:
Review invoices, payment requests and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.
Ensure payments are properly approved and within established authorization limits.
Ensure expenditure is correctly classified and allocated to the appropriate business, department or cost center.
Maintain accurate vendor and supplier records.
Reconcile supplier statements and resolve outstanding differences.
Monitor staff advances, operational expenses and other accountable funds.
Ensure timely retirement and reconciliation of all advances.
Prevent duplicate payments, unsupported expenditure and unauthorized transactions.
Monitor outstanding liabilities and ensure they are accurately reported.
Financial Controls and Risk Management:
Design, implement and continuously improve financial policies and internal controls.
Establish appropriate approval limits, documentation standards and segregation of duties.
Review financial transactions for accuracy, completeness and compliance with company policies.
Identify financial-control weaknesses, revenue leakage, fraud risks and process gaps.
Recommend and implement corrective measures for identified financial risks.
Maintain accurate fixed-asset, vendor, receivable, payable and staff-advance records.
Work with Risk and Internal Audit teams to resolve control issues and implement recommendations.
Protect the financial assets, records and confidential information of both businesses.
Promote financial discipline and accountability across the organization.
Taxation and Statutory Compliance:
Ensure the accurate and timely preparation and remittance of PAYE, VAT, withholding tax, pensions and other statutory obligations.
Maintain a compliance calendar covering all tax, regulatory and financial filing deadlines.
Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax laws and regulatory requirements.
Maintain accurate schedules and supporting documentation for all statutory remittances.
Liaise with tax authorities, pension administrators, auditors and other regulatory bodies.
Monitor changes in financial and tax regulations and advise management on their implications.
Address outstanding compliance matters and ensure timely resolution.
Audit and External Stakeholder Management:
Coordinate internal and external financial audits.
Prepare audit schedules and provide all required financial records and supporting documentation.
Respond to audit queries and ensure the timely resolution of audit findings.
Maintain organized records that are readily available for audit, regulatory and management review.
Work with external auditors, tax advisers, consultants and other professional service providers.
Support financial due diligence exercises involving investors, lenders or business partners.
Ensure that financial information provided to external stakeholders is accurate and properly authorized.
Operational and Commercial Support:
Partner with Operations, Commercial, Credit, Risk and Technology teams to improve financial performance.
Provide financial insights on transaction volumes, revenue, collections, margins and operating costs.
Review the financial performance of individual clients, parks, products, portfolios and operating locations.
Provide financial input into pricing, proposals, contracts and partnership negotiations.
Assess the financial viability of business initiatives and operational decisions.
Participate in monthly performance reviews and other relevant business meetings.
Ensure operational decisions are supported by accurate financial data and appropriate analysis.
Systems and Process Improvement:
Develop standard operating procedures for key finance activities.
Establish consistent reporting templates and reconciliation processes across both businesses.
Identify opportunities to automate financial reporting, collections reconciliation and payment processes.
Support the selection and implementation of appropriate accounting and financial-management systems.
Ensure finance systems and records remain accurate, secure and scalable.

Timeliness, accuracy and reliability of portfolio dashboards and reports.

Quality and actionability of insights and recommendations.
Turnaround time for priority portfolio analyses.
Consistency of metric definitions and reconciliation with source data.

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Hands-on experience building and maintaining Tableau dashboards.
Experience analysing credit bureau data and affordability, income or salary-verification signals is an advantage.
Strong SQL and data-analysis skills; proficiency in Excel is required.
Experience with Python or another analytical language is an advantage.

Strong understanding of consumer credit risk, portfolio monitoring and lending economics.
Working knowledge of vintage analysis, PAR and DPD, roll rates, cure rates, defaults, recoveries and loss trends.

Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail and sound commercial judgement.
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to manage priorities independently in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

Job Summary
A reputable and fast-growing Tier-2 Microfinance Bank operating in Ikere, Ekiti State, is seeking an experienced, analytical, and results-driven financial professional to serve as its Head of Credit.
The successful candidate will lead the Credit Division, overseeing the entire credit life cycle—from appraisal and risk assessment to disbursement, portfolio monitoring, and recovery.
The Head of Credit will be responsible for building a high-quality loan portfolio, maintaining non-performing loans (NPLs) within regulatory thresholds, and aligning lending operations with Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) guidelines.
Key Responsibilities
Credit Strategy & Policy: Formulate, review, and implement credit policies and underwriting standards aligned with CBN guidelines and the bank’s risk appetite.

Credit Appraisal & Underwriting: Evaluate, structure, and approve or recommend credit requests for MSMEs, group lending, and retail clients.
Risk Assessment: Identify, measure, and mitigate credit risk across all loan products, ensuring adequate provisioning and credit loss protection.
Loan Recovery & Workout: Direct credit recovery operations, manage default portfolios, and supervise legal and field recovery teams.
Product Development: Partner with business development teams to design, test, and roll out market-relevant loan products tailored to the local economic environment.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensure full compliance with CBN credit risk management frameworks, NDIC guidelines, and internal governance policies.
Team Leadership & Capacity Building: Supervise, mentor, and build capacity among credit analysts, loan officers, and field recovery personnel.
Board & Executive Reporting: Prepare and present periodic portfolio quality, loan performance, and credit risk management reports to the Management and Board Credit Committee.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Banking & Finance, Accounting, Economics, Agricultural Economics, or a related discipline; a Master’s degree is an added advantage.
Experience: Minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience in financial services, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or managerial credit role within a Microfinance Bank or Deposit Money Bank.

Technical Skills: Deep expertise in MSME lending, group lending dynamics, credit scoring, loan workout structures, and core banking software (e.g., BankOne, Finrak).
Local Knowledge: Solid understanding of the Ekiti State business environment, micro-entrepreneurial trends, and agricultural value chains.
Soft Skills: Strong analytical capabilities, sound judgment, negotiation skills, leadership, and uncompromised personal integrity.

Attractive and performance-based, commensurate with experience and industry standards.
